article.articleHeadline: Malaria Vaccine Shows 87% Efficacy in Clinical Trial
article.articleSummary: Malaria vaccine PfSPZ-LARC2 achieved 87% efficacy in a Phase 1 trial (22 participants) by preventing infection after deliberate parasite exposure. In a controlled challenge 12–16 weeks post-vaccination, all seven placebo recipients (n=7) were infected, while only two of 15 vaccine recipients developed infection. All infections were treated safely; the vaccine was safe and well tolerated. The study, presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting in Washington, D.C., was conducted by UW Medicine and partners as part of the IDCRC, sponsored by NIAID. Enrollment began Summer 2025. Testing occurred at UW Medicine in Seattle. The live-attenuated PfSPZ-LARC2 strain contains two genetic deletions that halt growth in the liver; the vaccine strain is from West Africa, while the challenge strain is from Brazil, testing cross-strain protection. Sanaria Inc. manufactured and advanced the vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアワクチン、臨床試験で87%の有効性を示す

article.articleHeadline: सर्दी में बकरियों पर मंडराया 2 बीमारियों का खतरा, ये लक्षण दिखें तो सावधान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two diseases threaten goats in winter; beware if these symptoms appear.
article.articleSummary: Winter elevates the risk of pneumonia and Peste des petits ruminants (PPR), or goat plague, among goats in Balod district, India. Agricultural Science Centre Balod veterinarian Dr. Neetu Sonkar notes that pneumonia typically shows sneezing, nasal discharge, and fever, while PPR presents with fever, cold, coughing, sneezing, and—in some cases—mouth ulcers. Small kids are most affected. Preventive measures include timely vaccination, with government-provided free vaccination. Farm owners should contact the local veterinary department to immunize goats. Keep animals in dry, clean, well-ventilated housing; avoid wet floors, which raise pneumonia risk. If symptoms appear, isolate suspected cases immediately and seek veterinary care rather than attempting home remedies. The diseases impact growth in kids and milk yield in adults, underscoring the importance of sanitation, housing, and vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus now 'out of control' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) worsens; Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine. As of 20 November 2026, the DRC reports 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths, with a few exported cases in neighboring countries. Declared in May, the outbreak is spreading faster and more deadly than earlier outbreaks. UNICEF notes about half of infected DRC patients die; under-fives mortality reaches 72%. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, overstretched health services, and shortages of staff and supplies hinder containment. MSF warns aid often does not reach hardest-hit areas. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and two deaths, almost all linked to travel from the DRC and was declared free in August; Kenya reports 9 cases and two deaths with seven recoveries. Tearfund provides PPE and survivor support; frontline workers face fear and pay shortages. Nurse Henri highlights risk and need for support; post-Ebola syndrome is observed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染が「制御不能」に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチンなし）がDRCで1万人超の感染・5千人超の死亡という大規模アウトブレイクとなり、周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア）への越境感染も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Seven in Ten Infected Children Are Dying: What Ebola Response Got Wrong in Six Months
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after the 16 May 2026 PHEIC declaration. As of 14 November 2026, 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths (CFR 48.9%) have been reported, with 400–500 new cases weekly across 67 health zones in eight provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. Two in three deaths occur in communities rather than treatment centres; children bear a heavy burden—over a quarter of cases are under 18, about one‑third of deaths, and seven in ten under‑five fatalities. Response gaps include surveillance weaknesses and more than 80% of new cases outside contact lists; insecurity such as the Cantine‑Aloya attack. About two‑thirds of the US$2.9 billion pledged remains undisbursed, delaying tracers, PPE and cold‑chain. Kenya reports nine cases (two deaths) linked to its first case; Nigeria one case in October. Calls for donor transparency, tracing updates and paediatric care protocols.

article.articleHeadline: 한-미 감염병 위협 공동 대응 위한 협력방안 논의
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korea–U.S. Discuss Cooperation Measures for a Joint Response to Infectious Disease Threats
article.articleSummary: In Seoul on 2026-11-20, Korea's Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA) and the U.S. CDC, led by John MacArthur of the East Asia-Pacific Office, discussed measures for a joint response to infectious disease threats. Building on exchanges since the 2024 establishment of the CDC’s East Asia-Pacific Office, the talks covered public health data use, pathogen surveillance systems, and laboratory biosafety, with a focus on leveraging data and artificial intelligence for early outbreak detection. Officials sought concrete collaborative projects and ways to strengthen health security across the Asia-Pacific region. KDCA Commissioner Im Seung-kwan emphasized trust and close communication between partners and committed to deepening collaboration with the CDC to bolster regional health security.

article.articleHeadline: Pentingnya Nutrisi Melawan Polusi hingga Musim Influenza untuk Jaga Kesehatan Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Importance of Nutrition in Fighting Pollution Through the Influenza Season to Safeguard Children's Health.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season and air pollution challenge children's health in Jakarta, Indonesia, as discussed in Nutrilon Royal's educational session held during Mombee World Jakarta at The Hall, Senayan City. The talk, led by pediatrician Dr. Miza Afrizal Azwir and parenting creator Aaliyah Massaid, emphasizes building a strong, early immune foundation to withstand environmental stressors and viral exposures such as Influenza A. It highlights that immune development begins at birth, with initial probiotic exposure shaping gut microbiota. The mode of delivery influences microbiome formation: cesarean delivery may delay colonization by beneficial Bifidobacterium compared with vaginal birth, potentially impacting early immune maturation during a critical window. The message advocates proactive, whole child support, nutrition, environment, and microbiome health, as a preventive strategy in the face of pollution and fluctuating seasons affecting children in Jakarta.

article.articleSummary: An online vaccination consultation titled 'Prevent RSV, influenza, pneumonia & other respiratory diseases in children and adults' is hosted by the VNVC Vaccination System. The program features Dr. Truong Huu Khanh (Vice Chairman, Ho Chi Minh City Infectious Diseases Association), Dr. Tran Huynh Tan (Medical Manager, VNVC), and Dr. Dang Thi Mai Khuê (Respiratory Unit, Tam Anh General Hospital, Ho Chi Minh City). Broadcast platforms include Thanh Nien, vnvc.vn, tamanhhospital.vn, VNVC and Tam Anh Hospital pages/channels, plus YouTube and TikTok. Readers can follow updates or call 028 7102 6595 or visit vnvc.vn to consult and schedule vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Genetic Mapping Across DR Congo Shows Regional Patterns of Antimalarial
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria across the Democratic Republic of Congo shows regional resistance patterns. High-throughput genotyping of samples from 16 of 26 provinces (100–200 patients per sentinel clinic) using MOSAIC reveals few Pfk13 variants linked to artemisinin resistance, but marked geographic variation in partner-drug resistance markers Pfcrt and Pfmdr1. In eastern provinces bordering the Great Lakes, Pfcrt/Pfmdr1 markers associated with 4-aminoquinoline resistance are common, indicating higher risk of artesunate-amodiaquine failure. In northern and southern regions, Pfmdr1 and Pfcrt haplotypes linked to artemether-lumefantrine failure predominate. The study supports integrating genomic surveillance with sentinel networks to tailor malaria treatment and chemoprevention at administrative level 1, offering early warnings of emerging resistance as of 2026-11-20.

article.articleHeadline: Multilevel Barriers Hinder Rural Dog Rabies Vaccination in Kilosa District
article.articleSummary: Kilosa District, Morogoro, Tanzania, a qualitative study in One Health Outlook identifies multilevel barriers to canine rabies vaccination. Nyamhanga and Masawe show individual, organizational, and community factors dampen routine campaigns in this endemic rural setting. Data collected April 6–June 30, 2026 include 12 focus groups (78 participants; 40 men, 38 women) and 7 key informant interviews, analyzed via an adapted socioecological model. Tanzania’s canine vaccination coverage is about 37.24%, far below the 70% target; the country is in Phase II of the global elimination framework. District records show 14 rabid dog-bite cases from 2024 to January 2026, including a fatality in a 3-year-old child, underscoring containment gaps. At the individual level, limited rabies literacy, misperceptions about vaccination timing, and unclear pricing drive financial deprioritization. Organizational fragmentation and lack of a One Health delivery model further hinder vaccination efforts.

article.articleHeadline: النشاط العالمي لكوفيد-19 منخفض مع تباين في معدلات الانتشار بين الدول
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global COVID-19 activity is low, with variation in transmission rates among countries.
article.articleSummary: Global COVID-19 activity remains low as of the week ending November 1, with regional variation. WHO data show a global test positivity of 4% from over 126,000 tests in 83 countries, identifying 5,127 infections. Europe has the highest regional positivity at 8% (up from 7.7%), followed by the Americas 4.2% (3.8%), Africa 3.2% (1.9%), Eastern Mediterranean 2.8% (2.1%), Southeast Asia 0.6% (0.39%), and the Western Pacific 0.81% (0.9%). In 28 days from Oct 5 to Nov 1, 59 countries reported 53,207 new cases, down from 71,685 in the prior 28 days. England shows stable signals with 7% positivity through Nov 15 and 1,826 COVID-19 hospitalizations (vs 1,792). Hong Kong’s week 46 positivity fell to 0.12% (10/8,640), vs 16 positives previously. WHO cautions that reporting/testing differences may understate true activity and complicate cross-country comparisons.

article.articleHeadline: Hoại tử niêm mạc phế quản do lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Necrosis of the bronchial mucosa due to tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Endobronchial tuberculosis presenting as necrosis of the bronchial mucosa in Hanoi, Vietnam: a 75-year-old man with three months of productive cough, wheeze, and dyspnea. Despite no fever or weight loss, CT with 3D bronchial reconstruction showed severe left main bronchus stenosis and bilateral bronchiectasis; bronchoscopy revealed multiple mucosal lesions with white pseudomembranes occluding airways. Seven biopsy specimens demonstrated chronic bronchitis with extensive necrosis. Sputum or lavage tests confirmed Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection in the airways, consistent with endobronchial tuberculosis. He was started on anti-tuberculosis therapy for 6–12 months; after two weeks, cough and sputum improved. Long-standing inflammation risks fibrosis and persistent airway narrowing; if bronchoscopy reveals critical stenosis, dilation or stenting may be needed. Endobronchial TB can be missed on X-ray or chest CT, so unilateral, persistent respiratory symptoms warrant targeted bronchoscopy even without typical pulmonary TB signs.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS recense 11 432 cas confirmés et 5 593 décès au 15 novembre 2026 - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO records 11,432 confirmed cases and 5,593 deaths as of November 15, 2026 - Mali Actu.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains at high, sustained transmission, according to the WHO’s 27th situation report (November 2026). As of November 15, 2026, the DRC reports 11,432 confirmed cases and 5,593 deaths. Daily new infections average 62–65, with a 6.7% decline over the past three weeks. The outbreak spans 68 health zones across eight provinces, with new cases in Watsa, Haut-Uélé. Ituri is the most affected province, recording 227 new cases in the studied week, followed by Nord-Kivu with 169. The October 22 tally stood at 9,816 cases and 4,757 deaths; between Oct 22 and Nov 15, totals rose by 1,616 cases and 836 deaths. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, unpaid-salary strikes, and resistance to safe burials. An Oct 14 Nairobi briefing urged better public information on Ebola; Nigeria reports 62 contacts completed follow-up; Kenya's last patient left hospital on Nov 11, 2026. Surveillance remains essential in DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Global Scoping Review Reveals Climate Warming Accelerates Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Global climate warming accelerates chikungunya transmission and expands its geographic footprint. A scoping review of 104 English-language studies (2000–Nov 1, 2025) concludes ambient temperature is the primary driver of viral spread in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Autochthonous transmission is now documented in more than 100 countries and territories, with major epidemics across Southeast Asia, South Asia, Indian Ocean islands, and the Americas. A July 2025 surge produced more than 10,000 confirmed cases in Foshan, Guangdong, China by August, the country’s largest outbreak on record. The optimal transmission window centers on 23-30°C; below 17°C reduces vector competence, while above 35°C diminishes mosquito survival and viral replication. Rainfall has mixed effects; moderate precipitation promotes breeding, heavy rainfall can flush habitats, and a 1-4 week lag between rainfall and case spikes is consistent. The study notes imbalanced preventive preparedness in low-income and endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な気候温暖化がチクングニア熱の感染拡大と地理的拡大を加速させることを示すスコーピングレビュー
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は気候変動とチクングニア熱伝播に関する学術的スコーピングレビューであり、新規の発生速報ではない。ただし中国広東省仏山での2025年7月の大規模流行（1万例超、中国史上最大）への言及があり、今後の動向確認のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2000年〜2025年11月1日までの104件の英語論文を対象とした学術レビューであり、速報的な新規発生情報ではない。中国広東省仏山での2025年7月〜8月のアウトブレイク（1万例超、過去最大規模）は既知情報の可能性が高く、新規シグナルとしての価値は限定的。カナリア諸島・スペイン・英領インド洋地域は対象国リストに該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis dan Antraks Jadi Perhatian, DIY Perkuat Surveilans
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis and Anthrax Are a Concern, DIY Strengthens Surveillance.
article.articleSummary: On 19–20 November 2026 in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, Kemenko PMK and the DIY Regional Government strengthened community-based surveillance (SBM) for zoonoses, with FAO Indonesia support, to anticipate leptospirosis and anthrax. The effort uses a One Health approach, linking human, animal, and environment health, and emphasizes integrating SBM with existing official services via the Lapor Cepat, Tepat, dan Aman reporting principles rather than creating new systems. The Forum PRB will act as a cross-sector network to detect early signals and promptly alert authorities. In DIY, leptospirosis recorded 153 cases and 38 deaths in 2025; human anthrax cases were 36 in 2023 and 38 in 2024. RKTL plans for 30/60/90-day follow-ups cover socialization, service mapping, and local mentoring at kelurahan level, with strong collaboration among BPBD, Health, Agriculture and Food Security, puskesmas, puskeswan, kelurahan, and volunteers.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症と炭疽病が懸念に、ジョグジャカルタ特別州がサーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジョグジャカルタでの既知の風土病（レプトスピラ症・炭疽病）に対する行政のサーベイランス強化策を報じる記事であり、新規の異常なアウトブレイクではないが、人獣共通感染症対策の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ക്രിസ്മസ് കാലത്തെ താറാവ്, കോഴി വിപണിയിൽ ഇത്തവണയും 'പനി ബാധ'; കർഷകരും കച്ചവടക്കാരും ദുരിതത്തിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Christmas-season turkey and chicken markets hit again this time by 'fever'; farmers and traders in distress.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) disrupts Christmas poultry markets in Kerala’s Alappuzha district, with culling of more than 18,000 birds in Chennithala and Ampalappuzha North after fever-like illness. Infections confirmed in these areas; other flocks show no symptoms. Sales are restricted within 10 km of outbreak sites, and culling losses remain largely uncompensated for months. Small units (~5,000 birds) are common. Kerala egg supply is tight; eggs from Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu (Namakkal) spoil quickly, reducing trader demand. Some farmers ship birds to Tamil Nadu for rearing and later return to Kerala markets. The All Kerala Poultry Federation calls for an urgent district monitoring committee including federation representatives and faster compensation; notes diagnostic results can take up to 10 days and urges rapid testing to mitigate ongoing economic damage to farming, food, and tourism sectors.

triage.headline_ja: クリスマス商戦期のアヒル・鶏市場で再び『発熱被害』、農家と業者が苦境に（ケララ州）
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽の鳥インフルエンザ発生による殺処分と経済的被害が報告されているが、ヒト感染例は確認されておらず、既存の季節的発生パターンの一環とみられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州アラップーザ県の家禽（アヒル・鶏）における鳥インフルエンザ発生と経済的影響（殺処分18,000羽超、販売制限、補償遅延）を報告。ヒト感染の記載はなし。アンドラ・プラデシュ州やタミル・ナードゥ州は卵取引の文脈でのみ言及されており、発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Quyết liệt phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Determined to prevent and control dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang, Vietnam faces a dengue fever surge. In week 45 of 2026, 8,782 cases were logged (286.5 per 100,000) with 58 outbreaks; year-to-date to Nov 15: 10,724 cases and 704 outbreaks, including one pediatric death from severe dengue with pneumonia. Hospitals are strained: Son Tra Regional Medical Center now admits ~200–250 patients daily (up from 100–120), while Da Nang Obstetrics–Pediatrics Hospital handles 50–100 outpatient visits daily, about 30% of inpatients worsening to severe dengue with hemorrhage, liver and muscle injury; overweight children are at higher risk. Authorities report over 170,000 dengue cases city-wide, with notable severe risk in adults, and mandate reinforced vector control and public education. Measures include larval source reduction, environmental sanitation, and aerial/ground spraying; health facilities are urged to prepare adequately. A disease-mapping surveillance system is being built, with 20 high-incidence communes prioritized and 83 of 93 wards under monitoring by mid-November.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の予防・対策に断固として取り組む
triage.triage_reason: ダナン市で大規模なデング熱の流行が続き、死亡例や医療機関の逼迫が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・規模の異常性）が2つ該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・ダナン市での季節性デング熱流行の大規模化を報じており、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の兆候は現時点でない。重症例・死亡例・医療逼迫が顕著であり、継続的なベクター対策と監視体制強化が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher morre após contrair HIV; homem é procurado por transmitir vírus e fugir com dinheiro dela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman dies after contracting HIV; man sought for transmitting the virus and fleeing with her money.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil: HIV infection led to the death of Célia, a mother of seven who transferred about R$100,000 to online acquaintance Deyvidd under the pretext of funding a Japanese restaurant. After the transfer, Célia developed health problems and was diagnosed with HIV, dying from complications. Luana, Célia’s daughter-in-law, uncovered a pattern of online dating scams by Deyvidd that omitted his HIV status. In Rio de Janeiro, Renata, another victim, tested HIV-positive after being warned by Célia’s family. The case drew attention as potential additional victims appeared in other states. Police are actively seeking Deyvidd, who is charged with fraud (estelionato) and bodily harm (lesão corporal).

triage.headline_ja: 女性がHIV感染後に死亡、ウイルスを感染させて金を奪い逃走した男を捜索中
triage.triage_reason: 個人間の詐欺・HIV感染事件であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や集団感染のリスクを示すものではないため、公衆衛生シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は詐欺事件に付随する個別のHIV感染報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生事例ではない。社会的関心（報道）はあるが公衆衛生リスクとしての基準は満たさない。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Bumi Makin Panas, Nyamuk Pembawa DBD dan Malaria Kini Menjangkau Dataran Tinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world is getting warmer, dengue-carrying mosquitoes and malaria are now reaching the highlands.
article.articleSummary: Batu City, East Java (elev. ~921 m, 15–19°C) reported 96 dengue fever (DBD) and dengue shock syndrome (DSS) cases from January–October 2026, illustrating climate change reshaping Indonesia’s vector-borne disease map. Nationally, dengue cases reached 257,271 with 1,461 deaths in 2024, while malaria rose to 706,297 in 2025, about 95% of cases from Papua. Mosquito biology drives the trend: warmer temperatures accelerate mosquito development and pathogen replication, and rainfall creates abundant breeding sites. However, excessively hot conditions can reduce mosquito survival, so risk rises within a warm, humid range. El Niño and La Niña further modulate these effects. Dr. Ardi Santoso of RS Kasih Ibu Solo notes climate–health dynamics particularly impact children. The findings indicate ongoing regional and national outbreaks, with dengue and malaria encroaching into highland areas as the climate warms.

triage.headline_ja: 地球温暖化で、デング熱とマラリアを媒介する蚊が高地にまで到達
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動によるベクター媒介疾患の分布拡大という構造的トレンドを扱う解説記事であり、急性の異常事態ではないが、デング熱・マラリアの罹患数増加と高地への拡大という継続的動向のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア国内（東ジャワ州バトゥ市、パプア州など）の気候変動とベクター媒介疾患の関連性を論じた解説記事。パプアニューギニアは発生地域に含まれるが記事主題ではないため除外。急性アウトブレイクの速報ではなく、長期トレンドの分析記事のため、フルRRAよりも継続的なモニタリングが適切。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 11 432 cas d'Ebola confirmés et 5 593 décès au 15 novembre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: 11,432 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,593 deaths as of November 15, 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of November 15, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 11,432 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,593 deaths due to Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The WHO compares the latest three weeks with the prior three weeks, noting an average of 62–65 new infections per day. New cases have appeared in Watsa, Haut-Uele. In the studied week, Ituri reported 227 new cases and North Kivu 169. Ongoing insecurity, salary-related strikes, and community resistance to safe burials hinder response efforts. The WHO deems persistent transmission a reason to maintain heightened public health measures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:2026年11月15日時点でエボラ確定症例11,432例、死亡5,593例
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ（スーダン/ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率が高く、治安悪化や安全な埋葬への抵抗により対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約49%と高く、治安不安、給与遅配によるストライキ、安全な埋葬への地域社会の抵抗が対応を妨げている。WHOは継続的な感染拡大を理由に公衆衛生対策の強化を維持する必要があるとしている。

article.articleHeadline: Chó thả rông làm tăng nguy cơ phơi nhiễm bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Free-roaming dogs increase the risk of rabies exposure.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a community threat in Hanoi due to free-roaming dogs. From the start of 2026 to date, Hanoi has recorded eight rabies outbreaks among domestic dogs in six communes: Doai Phuong, Ha Bang, Hoa Lac, Kieu Phu, Thach That, and Yen Xuan. Although human rabies cases were not reported from 2023–2025, dog outbreaks occurred in eight wards/communes during 2023–2025. Persistent dog management challenges heighten bite risk and obscure infection status. Rabies is a highly fatal acute viral infection transmitted mainly by bites, scratches, or saliva contact; vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis (including vaccine and immunoglobulin) can prevent disease. Preventive measures: vaccinate pets on schedule, leash/muzzle in public, isolate/report sick or dead animals; wash exposures with soap for at least 15 minutes and seek medical care. Authorities should boost public education and enforcement; Decree 204/2026/NĐ-CP imposes 1–2 million VND fines for not muzzling/leashing dogs in public.

triage.headline_ja: 放し飼いの犬が狂犬病感染リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: ハノイで放し飼いの犬による狂犬病流行が続いているが、2023-2025年にヒト感染例の報告はなく、既知の風土病的状況であるため緊急性は低いが、動物間の流行継続により経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例は報告されていないが、犬の間での狂犬病流行が複数地区で継続しており、放し飼い犬の管理不備がリスク要因となっている。地方当局による取り締まり強化が進められている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Lọc máu 17 lần cứu bé gái sốt xuất huyết suy đa cơ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seventeen hemodialysis sessions saved a girl with dengue fever and multi-organ failure.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old girl, Xuân An, in Đồng Nai, Vietnam, survived dengue fever complicated by multi-organ failure after 17 hemodialysis sessions over two months, plus mechanical ventilation and two therapeutic plasma exchanges. She presented with high fever, abdominal pain, markedly elevated liver enzymes (ALT ~24,500 U/L), abdominal hypertension, renal failure, and coagulopathy, followed by bacterial multidrug-resistant pneumonia, fungal pneumonia, and bladder hemorrhage. Discharged October 13, she gradually recovered and, at follow-up, could eat, sleep well, care for herself, and return to school with near-normal labs. As of mid-November 2026, the ICU in Đồng Nai reports 2–5 daily cases of severe dengue with shock and severe liver injury. Dengue vaccine info: Takeda vaccine, produced in Germany, has been used in Vietnam since Sept 2024; two doses 3 months apart; approved in 34 countries with over 32 million doses by July. Efficacy (NEJM 2019): ~80.2% against symptomatic dengue and ~95.4% against hospitalization; reinfection possible across four serotypes. Vaccination is advised after recovery (~6 months) and timing relative to pregnancy is important (avoid pregnancy within 3 months before vaccination; vaccinate before pregnancy).

triage.headline_ja: 17回の血液透析でデング熱による多臓器不全の女児を救命
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの単一重症例報告だが、ICUで連日2〜5件の重症デング熱症例が報告されており、季節的な流行動向として継続観察が必要。地域的流行は既知であり新規性・国際拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: ドイツは製造国としてワクチン文脈でのみ言及されており、発生国ではないため除外。記事は個別症例の詳細報告だが、同地域ICUでの重症デング熱多発という背景情報があり、季節的流行状況の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: China Surveillance Data Reveals Dynamic Shifts in Bacterial Antimicrobial
article.articleSummary: China's CHINET nationwide surveillance analyzed 516,309 non-duplicate clinical bacterial isolates from 80 institutions across 31 provincial divisions in 2025, a 12.7% rise from 2024. Gram-negative bacilli accounted for 71.5% and Gram-positive cocci 28.5%, with Escherichia coli, Klebsiella spp., Staphylococcus aureus, Enterococcus spp., and Pseudomonas aeruginosa as the top taxa. Among 12,755 Staphylococcus aureus isolates, methicillin resistance declined to 28.4% from 29.2% in 2024; MRSE and MRCNS also fell (to 80.8% and 76.5%, respectively). No vancomycin-resistant Staphylococcus detected; linezolid resistance noted in some coagulase-negative species. Enterococci (45,346 isolates) showed rising glycopeptide resistance, with vancomycin resistance in Enterococcus faecium at 8.4% (up 3.3 points from 2024); E. faecium remains highly ampicillin-resistant (92.4%), while E. faecalis shows lower ampicillin resistance but higher linezolid resistance (4.0%). Streptococcus pneumoniae remains largely penicillin-susceptible: children 96.1%, adults 94.1%.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のサーベイランスデータが示す細菌の薬剤耐性パターンの動的変化
triage.triage_reason: 全国的な抗菌薬耐性サーベイランスの定期報告であり、急性の公衆衛生事象やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: この記事は耐性菌サーベイランスの年次統計報告であり、特定のアウトブレイクや急性公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận 8 ổ dịch dại, Hà Nội cảnh báo tình trạng chó thả rông
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight rabies outbreaks recorded; Hanoi warns about roaming dogs.
article.articleSummary: Eight dog rabies outbreaks have been recorded in Hanoi in 2026, with roaming dogs in districts continuing to raise safety and transmission risks. Hanoi CDC notes roaming dogs on streets and in residential areas lacking supervision. Rabies is a deadly virus transmitted mainly by bites or saliva contact; once symptoms appear, fatalities approach 100%, though vaccination and timely post-exposure treatment can prevent death. From 2020–2022 Hanoi reported 1–2 rabies deaths annually; 2023–2025 saw no human cases but 14 dog outbreaks across eight wards. In 2026 these outbreaks span six communes: Đoài Phương (3), Hà Bằng (2), Hòa Lạc (1), Kiều Phú (1), Thạch Thất (1), Yên Xuân (1). Decree 204/2026 fines unvaccinated dogs and muzzle/leash violations (1–2 million VND); Decree 282/2025 imposes 500k–1M for roaming animals and 2–3M for damages. Preventive measures: vaccinate and keep records; leash and muzzle dogs; seek medical care promptly after bites.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病発生8件を記録、ハノイが放し飼いの犬に警告
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでの犬の狂犬病流行は例年発生している地域的・動物由来の公衆衛生課題であり、ヒトの死亡例も報告されておらず、国際的な拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで地域流行性の課題であり、本記事はハノイ市当局による放し飼い犬対策・罰則強化に関する注意喚起記事。2023-2025年はヒト死亡例なし、動物間流行の管理強化に焦点。

article.articleHeadline: PBO Restores Insecticide Sensitivity in Resistant Ghanaian Malaria Vectors
article.articleSummary: In Ghana's forest-savannah transition zone, Anopheles gambiae s.s. dominate in Kintampo North Municipality and Kintampo South District. Multiclass insecticide resistance is observed: malathion (5%) induces 100% mortality at 24 hours, while propoxur (1%), DDT (4%), and alpha-cypermethrin (0.05%) yield mortality below WHO susceptibility thresholds. Intensity bioassays show high-intensity pyrethroid resistance, with mortality remaining under 98% even at tenfold diagnostic alpha-cypermethrin concentration. Preexposure to the synergist piperonyl butoxide fully restores susceptibility, implicating oxidase-mediated metabolic resistance alongside the kdr-West L1014F mutation detected in most resistant specimens. Implications point to potential use of PBO-treated nets and organophosphate tools, pending field validation. The study fills surveillance gaps in Ghana's malaria transmission belt and underscores the need for continued entomological, epidemiological, and programmatic evaluations before deployment.

triage.headline_ja: PBOがガーナのマラリア媒介蚊における殺虫剤抵抗性を回復させる
triage.triage_reason: 殺虫剤抵抗性に関する昆虫学的研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や症例急増を示すものではなく、社会的関心やIHR基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア媒介蚊の殺虫剤抵抗性に関する学術研究報告であり、疾病発生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: One Health Investigation Confirms Scrub Typhus Transmission and Risk
article.articleSummary: Block-A in Sundargarh district, Odisha, experienced active local transmission of scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) during 2023, confirmed by a One Health epidemiological and entomological field investigation tied to earlier September fatal reports. Descriptive surveillance recorded 151 laboratory-confirmed scrub typhus cases in Block-A in 2023 (5.6 per 10,000 population) — the district’s highest block rate; cases rose from July, peaked in late September, and waned by November. Median age 30 (IQR 15–46); 55% male; 55% from semi-urban settings; children <15 years and young adults each 25%. Among 61 interviewed with IgM ELISA-confirmed infection (July–October 2023): 46% hospitalized, 20% developed MODS, 13% required ICU; 4 deaths (CFR 2.6%). Common symptoms: fever, headaches (64%), cough (39%), myalgia (34%); eschars in 13%. Exposure history linked to farm/forest visits; 72% IgG-positive among 43 tested, indicating prior exposure. Findings establish direct links between human behavior, vector/mite ecology, and severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: One Health調査がオディシャ州におけるツツガムシ病の感染伝播とリスク要因を確認
triage.triage_reason: 2023年に発生した過去のアウトブレイクに関する学術的な疫学調査報告であり、ツツガムシ病はインドで既知の風土病でヒト-ヒト感染もしないため、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2023年のオディシャ州Sundargarh地区におけるツツガムシ病流行の後方視的な疫学・昆虫学調査報告であり、ベクター媒介性（ダニ媒介）疾患でヒト-ヒト感染はしない。重症度（CFR 2.6%、ICU 13%）は一定あるが、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos de Covid faz soar alerta sobre necessidade de vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in COVID-19 cases raises alarm about the need for vaccination.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Brazil shows a rise in hospitalizations during Nov 1–7, 2026, notably in the Centro-Sul (Distrito Federal, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro) and the Northeast (Bahia). Cases remain mild and overall counts are low, but Fiocruz warns that the virus is circulating and stresses full vaccination. The Omicron subvariant XFG, first detected in Jan 2025, carries spike mutations that may increase transmissibility; the WHO notes no clear evidence of greater severity. Vaccination guidance: initial doses for children 6 months–5 years; a booster for pregnant women; vaccination every six months for adults aged 60+ and immunocompromised; annual boosters for other priority groups like health workers and those with comorbidities. Vaccines are available via SUS, though logistics can hinder access; authorities propose mass vaccination drives (mutirões) in hotspots to improve uptake and reduce waste.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染者数の増加、ワクチン接種の必要性に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで新型コロナ入院者数が増加しワクチン接種の必要性が指摘されているが、症状は軽度で全体数も低く、国際的な拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は現時点で確認されない。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株XFGによる感染者増加であり、WHOは重症度上昇の明確な証拠はないとしている。ブラジル国内のワクチン接種推進が主題で、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態としての性質は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid fever rise observed -- DOH
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever in the country shows a rise: 1,141 cases were recorded for Oct 11–24, up from 1,101 for Sep 27–Oct 10. The year-to-date total is 16,432 typhoid cases, 28% lower than the 22,935 by the same period in 2025, with a case fatality rate of 0.30% (down 19% from 2025). Fifteen provinces and highly urbanized cities have breached epidemic thresholds and continue to rise. Cholera registered 27 cases Oct 11–24 (vs 16 in the prior window), with 551 cholera cases reported as of Nov 7 for the year, still lower than the 1,421 last year. Public health guidance urges seeking medical attention for persistent fever and related symptoms and emphasizes safe drinking water and thoroughly cooked food, noting El Niño–related water challenges as a factor.

triage.headline_ja: 腸チフスの増加を確認 ― 保健省（DOH）
triage.triage_reason: 15州で流行閾値を超えた腸チフスの増加がみられるが、年間累計は前年より減少し致死率も低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: エルニーニョに伴う水供給問題が一因とされる季節的な腸チフス・コレラの増加に関する保健省の国内サーベイランス報告。致死率は前年より低下しており、重大な公衆衛生危機とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: Membangun Fondasi Imunitas Anak di Tengah Polusi dan Musim Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Building the Foundation of Children's Immunity Amid Pollution and the Influenza Season.
article.articleSummary: Air pollution and erratic weather heighten the risk for young children during the influenza A season, emphasizing early immunity built through nutrition and healthy habits. Pediatric specialist Dr. Miza Afrizal Azwir, Sp.A, notes gut health as central to immunity, with birth method affecting intestinal bacterial colonization; cesarean births can delay Bifidobacterium establishment versus vaginal birth, though strong parental support with proper nutrition mitigates this. The Nutrilon Royal session at Mombee World Jakarta (Senayan City) highlighted synbiotics. Nutrilon Royal’s Nutrilon Acti+ C-Synbio combines FOS:GOS 1:9 with B. breve M-16V, clinically supporting immune foundations. A holistic approach—adequate and balanced nutrition, gut health, up-to-date immunizations, sufficient sleep, and hygiene—aims to prepare children to navigate a dynamic environment in Indonesia amid ongoing influenza activity.

triage.headline_ja: 大気汚染とインフルエンザ流行期における子どもの免疫基盤づくり
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康・育児情報記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の懸念事項に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は小児科医による栄養・免疫に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、インフルエンザの季節性への言及はあるが具体的な流行状況やアウトブレイクのデータは含まれていない。製品（Nutrilon Royal）の宣伝を含む内容。

article.articleHeadline: செங்கல்பட்டு உட்பட 6 மாவட்டங்களில் நவ. 22-ம் தேதி சிறப்பு போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special polio drops camp in six districts including Chengalpattu on Nov. 22.
article.articleSummary: Special National Polio Drops Day will be held on November 22 in six Tamil Nadu districts—Chengalpattu, Mayiladuthurai, Sivaganga, Thanjavur, Tirunelveli, and Virudhunagar. Aimed at delivering polio drops to 9.16 lakh children, camps will operate from 7:00 am to 5:00 pm at 6,647 centers including primary health centers, government hospitals, Anganwadi centers, nutrition centers, schools, and other key locations. All children under age five will receive drops, and the dose is to be administered on the day even if already vaccinated per the National Immunization Schedule; newborns also require doses. Tamil Nadu has remained polio-free for 22 years due to ongoing campaigns, but regional risk remains as neighboring countries report polio virus circulation; an expert panel identified 272 districts across 21 states as at-risk. This effort complements nationwide surveillance and immunization strategies.

triage.headline_ja: チェンガルパットゥを含む6県で11月22日に特別ポリオ経口ワクチン接種キャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の定期予防接種キャンペーンの実施告知であり、実際の症例報告や流行を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: タミル・ナードゥ州は22年間ポリオフリーを維持しているとの記載があり、本記事は予防的な定期接種キャンペーンの案内。周辺国でのポリオウイルス循環リスクへの言及はあるが、インド国内での実際の感染事例の報告ではないため発生国としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn đa kháng thuốc gia tăng, nhiều bệnh viện thiếu năng lực ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Multidrug-resistant bacteria on the rise; many hospitals lack the capacity to respond.
article.articleSummary: Antimicrobial resistance in Vietnam is rising. Among monitored bacteria, Acinetobacter baumannii shows 84.1% resistance to carbapenems; Klebsiella pneumoniae 46%; Staphylococcus aureus 76.5% methicillin-resistant; Escherichia coli 61.2% resistant to third-generation cephalosporins and 81.8% to quinolones. The national surveillance network covers 64 hospitals in 28 of 34 provinces, but remains a small fraction of Vietnam's >1,000 hospitals, with uneven lab capacity, reagent shortages, and limited data systems. Coordination gaps have led to undetected transmission clusters. Hospitals implementing stewardship and infection-control measures show gains: Cho Ray Hospital reports 12,419 reviewed cases (2021–Sept 2026) with antibiotic guideline adherence 95–99.6%; Bach Mai Hospital links antibiotic use, costs, and resistance, increasing meropenem appropriateness from 58.8% to 84.2%. WHO warns Vietnam could see about 300,000 AMR-related deaths (2020–2035); urges expanded surveillance, lab capacity, responsible antibiotic use, and sustained investment. Vietnam's national strategy 2023–2030 and action plan are being rolled out.

triage.headline_ja: 多剤耐性菌が増加、多くの病院が対応能力不足
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性菌の蔓延は公衆衛生上の長期的懸念だが、急性のアウトブレイクや国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はなく、AMRサーベイランス体制強化の文脈記事であるためWATCHと判定。
triage.notes: 本記事は急性アウトブレイクではなく、薬剤耐性菌（AMR）の国家的サーベイランス状況と課題に関する報告。WHOはベトナムで2020-2035年に約30万人のAMR関連死亡を警告しており、長期的な公衆衛生リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện 2 ổ dịch cúm A, quai bị trong trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two outbreaks of influenza A and mumps in schools.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and mumps outbreaks reported in Hải Ninh Commune, Quảng Ninh City, Vietnam. By 16 November 2026, Ly Thường Kiệt High School recorded 50 influenza A cases, and Hải Tiến Primary-Secondary School reported 19 mumps cases. The local health station (Trạm Y tế xã Hải Ninh) partnered with school authorities to conduct environmental disinfection with Chloramine B across over 20,000 m² at both campuses, targeting classrooms, common areas, and surrounding environments. Concurrent risk communication emphasizes recognition of influenza-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat) and mumps signs (facial/ear area swelling), plus hand hygiene and maintaining clean, ventilated spaces. Staff, students, and parents are advised to report suspected cases promptly; after one week, the health station will reassess outbreak risk and adjust controls accordingly. Context: Hai Phong City reported 3,252 influenza A cases across 106/114 communes by end of week 43 (Oct 19–26, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: クアンニン省の学校でインフルエンザAとおたふく風邪の集団発生2件
triage.triage_reason: 学校内でのインフルエンザA・おたふく風邪の集団発生だが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく地域の保健所が通常対応中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、学校という閉鎖環境での継続的な感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性のインフルエンザA・おたふく風邪の学校内集団発生。地元保健所が環境消毒とリスクコミュニケーションを実施中で、1週間後に再評価予定。ハイフォン市での広域インフルエンザA流行（10月時点で3,252例）との関連性にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kutai Timur ajak warga antisipasi DBD jelang musim hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kutai Health Office calls on residents to anticipate dengue fever ahead of the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: On 20 November 2026, East Kutai Regency Health Office in Sangatta, East Kalimantan urged residents to anticipate dengue fever (DBD) ahead of the rainy season. Health official Yuwana Sri Kurniawati stated that DBD case increases are expected to begin in January 2027, prompting rapid preventive actions. Climate conditions are shifting disease patterns and may heighten DBD risk as rainfall intensifies. Environments conducive to standing water can support Aedes aegypti breeding, the vector for DBD. Residents are urged to start prevention now, including keeping homes and surroundings clean and routinely eliminating mosquito breeding sites. The 3M campaign—emptying containers that hold water, covering water storage, and reusing or repurposing items likely to collect water—should be applied to reduce Aedes aegypti growth before heavy rains. Community involvement is essential to lower DBD transmission risk in Kutai Timur.

triage.headline_ja: 東クタイ県保健局、雨季を前に住民にデング熱への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に関する予防啓発の呼びかけであり、現時点での症例急増や異常事態の報告はなく、通常の季節的注意喚起に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な呼びかけであり、実際の症例数増加や異常発生の報告ではない。デング熱はインドネシアで季節性に毎年発生するため、通常の公衆衛生活動の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Enzy Storia Dirawat karena Virus dan Parasit Amuba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enzy Storia Hospitalized for Virus and Amoebic Parasite
article.articleSummary: Enzy Storia, Jakarta, is hospitalized with abdominal illness attributed to a virus and an amoebic parasite. The infection is amoebiasis, caused by Entamoeba histolytica, contracted via contaminated food or water. CDC notes many infections are asymptomatic, while others cause diarrhea, abdominal pain, or cramps; in severe cases, amoebic dysentery includes abdominal pain, bloody stools, and fever, and rare instances may spread to the liver forming an abscess. Enzy did not specify the virus type or lab-confirmation results, and the post does not confirm the exact causative parasite beyond ameba. Diagnosis relies on medical evaluation and stool samples, potentially repeated. Management emphasizes hydration for gastrointestinal viral illness and parasite-directed therapy per doctor's assessment. While Enzy has a history of autoimmune rheumatoid arthritis, the article does not link this to the current abdominal symptoms. No case counts reported.

triage.headline_ja: エンジー・ストリア、ウイルスとアメーバ寄生虫により入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の入院に関する単発事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 著名人の個人的な健康問題に関する芸能ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。症例数の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Mining Sector Donates $1.1 Million to Ebola Response as Cases Exceed 11,000 - MiningFocus Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths as of 14 November 2026, across eight provinces: Ituri (7,858/3,715), North Kivu (2,860/1,590), South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain. Four days to 14 November recorded 179 new infections and 97 deaths. WHO notes 400–500 weekly new cases; two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centres; children account for more than a quarter of infections and about one-third of deaths. International funding remains short: UN SG appeals for US$1.1 billion; current funding is under half; MSF warns of unpaid responders; insecurity includes health-facility attacks (81 verified). Kenya reports nine linked cases, two deaths. Mining sector contributes US$1.1 million on 17 November to the incident management system; earlier US$1 million from Chinese-owned miners; allocations undisclosed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の鉱業セクター、エボラ対応に110万ドルを寄付 ― 感染者数11,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが11,376症例・5,568死亡に達し、ケニアへの越境伝播も報告されている重大な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの関連9症例・2死亡が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株であり、資金不足・治安悪化（医療施設への攻撃81件）が対応を困難にしている点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Hujan 2026: Bukan Sekadar Sedia Payung, Ibu Perlu Lindungi Keluarga dari Ancaman Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 2026 Rainy Season: Not Just Ready with an Umbrella, Mothers Must Protect Their Families from Disease Threats.
article.articleSummary: Purwasuka and wider Indonesia face heightened disease threats with the 2026/2027 rainy season, notably dengue fever (DBD), diarrhea, and acute respiratory infections (ARI) tied to polluted environments. The BMKG projects the rainy season arriving gradually, with 185 Zona Musim (ZOM) entering in November and 266 ZOM in December 2026, underscoring regional variation in timing. No specific case counts or lab confirmations are provided. Families are advised to focus on prevention: ensure balanced nutrition with fruits, vegetables, carbohydrates, protein, and healthy fats; maintain safe, clean drinking water; adequate sleep; and regular handwashing with soap before meals, after toilet use, and after outdoor activities to cut transmission. Attention to the home environment is also needed, as repeated rainfall can leave standing water in open containers, plant pots, gutters, and drainage, creating hidden mosquito breeding sites that fuel DBD risk.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年の雨季：傘の準備だけでなく、母親は家族を病気の脅威から守る必要がある
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や検査確認がなく、雨季に向けた一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常性や緊急性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症発生事例の報告ではない。デング熱はインドネシアで言及されているが、具体的な症例数や地域特定がなく、対象国として明示する根拠が乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Polusi dan Virus Influenza Jadi Ancaman bagi Kesehatan Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pollution and the Influenza Virus Pose a Threat to Children's Health
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-20, air pollution, weather changes, and exposure to the influenza virus threaten children’s health, especially in early childhood when immunity is still developing. The article emphasizes that polluted air and viral exposure can trigger respiratory infections caused by influenza. Building immune resilience begins early through nutrition, hygiene, and healthy living. Pediatric specialist Miza Afrizal Azwir notes the gut microbiome’s key role in immunity, with birth mode influencing initial microbial colonization; cesarean delivery may delay beneficial bacteria like Bifidobacterium. Nutritional strategies—prebiotics and probiotics, and their synbiotic combination—help balance the gut microbiota. Immunizations, adequate sleep, hygiene, and a balanced diet remain essential. Nutrilon Acti+ C-Synbio, featuring prebiotic FOS:GOS 1:9 and probiotic B. breve M-16V, is presented as clinically supported to bolster the immune foundation. Parents are encouraged to foster consistent healthy habits to protect children during influenza season and amid pollution challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 大気汚染とインフルエンザウイルスが子どもの健康を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発・育児情報記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザや大気汚染への一般的な予防啓発および育児用製品（Nutrilon Acti+ C-Synbio）の紹介記事であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus cases raise concern in Northeast, doctors warn of delayed diagnosis
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus, caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by infected chiggers, is a growing public health concern in Northeast India, especially Assam, Mizoram and Nagaland. Transmission occurs in grasslands, fields and rodent-infested areas; it is not spread person-to-person. Symptoms include persistent fever, severe headache, myalgia and weakness; eschars occur in some patients. Delays in treatment can cause pneumonia, organ injury or death; early antibiotics are essential. National surveillance records 33 outbreaks in 2023 versus 14 in 2021; overall 127 outbreaks, 3,751 cases and 93 deaths (2009–2023). In eight NE states 2021–2024, 15 scrub typhus deaths were recorded (Assam, Mizoram and Nagaland four each; Manipur two; Sikkim one). A Dibrugarh hospital study (Oct 2024–Sept 2025) of 80 confirmed cases showed 8.75% mortality, with rural agricultural workers and a spring peak; multi-organ involvement is common. Protective clothing, boots, repellents and treating on clinical suspicion are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 北東インドでツツガムシ病の症例が懸念を高める、医師らは診断遅延に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 北東インド各州でツツガムシ病の症例・死亡が増加傾向にあり、医師が診断遅延への懸念を公に表明している。WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続）に複数該当し、社会的関心（報道による注意喚起）も見られるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はダニ媒介性で人-人感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし北東インド（アッサム、ミゾラム、ナガランド、マニプール、シッキム）で症例・死亡が増加傾向にあり、国内公衆衛生上の懸念として続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: शिवराज सिंह आज देश की पहली स्वदेशी H5N1 चिकन वैक्सीन करेंगे लॉन्च
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shivraj Singh will today launch the country's first indigenous H5N1 chicken vaccine.
article.articleSummary: India’s first indigenous H5N1 chicken vaccine, an inactivated shot targeting avian influenza clade 2.3.2.1a, has been developed by ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will launch and dedicate it to the nation, marking a major step in poultry disease control and human infection risk reduction. The vaccine aims to protect chickens from highly pathogenic avian influenza, mitigating outbreaks and the economic toll from culling and trade restrictions. Avian influenza (H5N1) can cause near 100% mortality in infected birds, with India reporting about 500 outbreaks to date. NIHSAD reports six-month safety in vaccinated birds and reduced transmission to-contact flocks, signaling strengthened domestic vaccine capacity and preparedness for future outbreaks and imports/exports.

triage.headline_ja: シヴラージ・シン氏、本日インド初の国産H5N1鶏ワクチンを発表へ
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発・発表に関する動物衛生分野の前向きなニュースであり、ヒト感染症例や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)の家禽用国産ワクチンの発表に関するもので、新規ヒト感染や動物アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。農業大臣によるワクチン発表という政府広報的内容。

article.articleHeadline: Dugaan Keracunan MBG di Kota Malang Meluas, Siswa TK Dharma Bakti Pertiwi Turut Jalani Rawat Inap
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected MBG poisoning in Malang City widens; Dharma Bakti Pertiwi Kindergarten students also undergo inpatient care.
article.articleSummary: Suspected MBG poisoning in Malang City widens as Dharma Bakti Pertiwi Kindergarten students require inpatient care after MBG meals distributed by SPPG Kedungkandang Madyopuro 2 on 17 November 2026. A TK Dharma Bakti Pertiwi child developed weakness and dizziness, then vomiting after returning home around 12:15; leukocytes and neutrophils were elevated, suggesting gastrointestinal infection or poisoning. The MBG package contained rice, crispy chicken, tofu, and melon. Additional reports indicate another student and a teacher may be affected; confirmation is pending. SPPG Kedungkandang Madyopuro 2 staff have visited RS Puri Bunda. Health authorities collected food samples for Labkesda testing and suspended the provider for 20 days starting 18 November 2026. Earlier, 11 patients were hospitalized; nine remain (one at Hermina, eight at Bhirawa Bhakti), overall improving. SPPG Madyopuro 2 is in BTU, Madyopuro, Kedungkandang, run by Yayasan Putra Pahlawan Dua, with a prior mid-2026 suspension for IPAL documentation issues.

triage.headline_ja: マラン市でのMBG(学校給食)食中毒疑いが拡大、ダルマ・バクティ・プルティウィ幼稚園の児童も入院
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食による集団食中毒疑いで患者が増加しているが、感染症（人-人感染）ではなく食品衛生事案であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。続報と検査結果の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 原因は給食(MBGプログラム)による食中毒疑いであり、感染症というより食品安全事案。保健当局が食品サンプルを検査中、提供者は20日間の業務停止。人-人感染のリスクはなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái viêm thị thần kinh do sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Little girl with optic neuritis due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old girl in Ho Chi Minh City developed optic neuritis linked to dengue fever. Seven days after a dengue episode, she experienced blurred vision; exams showed visual acuity counting fingers at ~3 meters and bilateral optic disc edema. MRI revealed enlargement and signal changes of the optic nerves, leading to optic neuritis. Clinicians suspected a post-infectious inflammatory/immune reaction after dengue infection. The treatment included intravenous corticosteroids, oral medication, and eye drops. After three days, inflammation subsided and color vision began returning; visual acuity recovered to 10/10 in the right eye and 6/10 in the left after one week, reaching 10/10 in both eyes after two weeks. Dengue can cause ocular complications such as conjunctival hemorrhage, macular edema, retinal hemorrhage, and optic neuritis. In Ho Chi Minh City, over 31,000 dengue cases were reported this year through Sept 6; vaccination and vector control are advised. Vision changes warrant ophthalmology assessment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による視神経炎を発症した少女
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の合併症報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。デング熱自体は既知の流行性疾患で地域では管理下にある。
triage.notes: 記事は個別症例報告（デング熱の稀な眼合併症である視神経炎）であり、流行状況自体への新規懸念を示すものではない。ホーチミン市の年間デング熱症例数（31,000件超）への言及があるが、これは既知の季節性流行の文脈。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Police Ordered to Enforce Ban On Concerts, Rallies in Ebola High-Risk Border Districts
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ministry of Health has ordered police to ban concerts, festivals, rallies in districts amid Ebola threats from the DRC. In a November 17 letter, Prof. Charles Olaro, DG Health Services, said National Task Force would maintain the suspension after November 3 assessment on importation. Police must obtain written clearance from the ministry before approving events. The measure aims to limit cross-border movement to mitigate transmission of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, active in DRC. The DRC had 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths on November 12 across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, South Ubangi, North Ubangi. Uganda’s May–June 2026 outbreak totaled 20 cases; WHO declared it over Aug 25 after 42 days without infections. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists; candidate vaccines are under study. Kenya and Nigeria have reported linked cases. The ministry did not list districts or a review date; MoH will update police.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラ出血熱高リスクの国境地域でコンサート・集会の禁止を徹底するよう警察に命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,197例・5,471人死亡という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大や渡航・集会制限が実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの対策措置を主題とするが、感染拡大源はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: [게시판] 에볼라바이러스병 유입 대비 관계기관 합동훈련
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Bulletin Board] Interagency Joint Drill to Prepare for the Introduction of Ebola Virus Disease
article.articleSummary: On 20 November 2026, Korea's Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA) led a multi-agency joint drill at sites in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, Sejong City, and Osong to prepare for the potential introduction of Ebola virus disease (EVD). The exercise simulated an importation linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and traced the full response from initial recognition and reporting of a suspected case to patient transport and diagnostic testing. Participants included regional disease response centers, the National Quarantine Service, and the 1339 Infectious Disease Expert Call Centre. KDCA Director Im Seung-kwan emphasized that high-risk pathogens demand rapid frontline action and tightly integrated coordination, and he said drills will continue to build a robust, real-world response system.

triage.headline_ja: [掲示板] エボラウイルス病の流入に備えた関係機関合同訓練
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国における訓練（演習）の実施報告であり、実際のエボラ発生事例ではないため、感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国KDCAによる訓練実施のニュースであり、DRCでの実際のエボラ発生状況についての新規情報は含まれていない。DRCでの発生は既知の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事自体のイベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: VDM hospitalised in China over life threatening "malaria" | Daily Champion | Voice of the Nation, Champion of the Truth.
article.articleSummary: Nigerian social media critic Martin Vincent Otse, aka VeryDarkMan (VDM), has been hospitalised in China with life-threatening malaria during a business trip. He said self-medication failed and doctors ordered quarantine for four to seven days. Otse, 32, said he nearly died on Wednesday night and has never slept in a hospital before; he will be quarantined for 4–7 days. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details beyond the malaria diagnosis and does not specify the infection source or whether this is an imported case. No death count or broader outbreak is mentioned. Published 2026-11-20; the piece frames this as a single medical emergency involving a Nigerian national in China, with limited clinical detail.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのSNS論客VDM、生命を脅かすマラリアで中国にて入院
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人の輸入性マラリア症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。社会的関心は著名人関連で一部あるが、公衆衛生イベントとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は個人の輸入マラリア症例であり、発生地域として記載されたナイジェリア・中国のいずれも対象国リストに含まれない（ナイジェリアは対象国外、中国は発生国ではなく診断地のため、記事の主題は中国での個人症例だが公衆衛生イベントとしての広がりはない）。中国は対象国リストに含まれるが、単一の輸入症例であり国内アウトブレイクを示唆する内容ではないため、公衆衛生シグナルとしての重要性は低いと判断しverified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: क्‍या स्‍वदेशी वैक्‍सीन से खत्‍म हो जाएगा H5N1 का खतरा?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will a domestically produced vaccine eliminate the threat of H5N1?
article.articleSummary: As of 20 November 2026, India unveiled its first domestically produced H5N1 vaccine for poultry, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD and launched by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal. The India-made vaccine aims to protect chickens against highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1), filling a gap as no such vaccine existed in the country before. Since 2006, India has reported over 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8, with direct and indirect losses estimated at ₹2,200–₹3,000 crore. H5N1 is an avian influenza A subtype primarily affecting wild birds and poultry, but it can infect other animals and humans, with human infection posing serious illness and high mortality risk. Outbreak control often requires culling, poultry-trade bans, and farmer losses. Regarding safety of chicken and eggs, US FDA/CDC say they are safe if well cooked; WHO recommends at least 70°C, CDC 74°C, and avoid raw eggs or undercooked poultry.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bareilly News: Bareilly division leads in confirming TB infection among suspected TB patients.
article.articleSummary: From August 2024 to August 2026, Bareilly division records the highest TB positivity among symptomatic individuals tested. Bareilly district shows a TB positivity rate of 28.5%, meaning about 29 of every 100 symptomatic people tested are TB-positive. Shahjahanpur is 25.4%, Badaun 22.6%, while Pilibhit is 17.2% (lowest). The data indicate in Bareilly and Shahjahanpur roughly one in four symptomatic individuals test TB-positive. District TB Officer Dr. Intizar Husain said awareness campaigns continue, with about 50 of 1,188 gram panchayats declared TB-free. Symptoms prompting testing include cough lasting over two weeks, persistent fever, night sweats, weight loss, and reduced appetite. Under the TB-Free India initiative, JOsh teams (launched on October 8) operate in 15 blocks and 20 urban areas, each with a nodal officer, five NCC cadets, and five My Bharat volunteers to educate, refer positives for treatment, and ensure full course.

article.articleSummary: Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, reports a fatal dengue case in a 3-year-old girl from Ea Wi hamlet, Krông Pắc commune. By 16 November 2026, CDC Dak Lak records 519 dengue cases and 11 outbreaks in Krông Pắc, with 3 outbreaks still active; Ea Wi logged 4 cases and 1 outbreak in early November. The child developed fever on 6 November, tested NS1 positive, and rapidly deteriorated to dengue shock with liver injury, coagulopathy, and multi-organ failure, requiring ICU care. Real-time RT-PCR confirmed Dengue virus type 1 (DENV-1). Vector-control measures include fogging at the patient’s home and 100 nearby households. Health authorities urge prompt medical care for children with high fever, severe abdominal pain, vomiting, or bleeding, and advise against self-treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết tăng mạnh tại TP.HCM, gần 2.500 ca mắc trong một tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever surges in Ho Chi Minh City, nearly 2,500 cases in a week.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, dengue fever rose to 2,428 cases in the week, up 25.7% from the four‑week average, totalling 49,232 through week 46. HFMD added 1,621 cases in week 46, year-to-date total 49,274. Incidence was highest in Con Dao, Ngai Giao Ward, Minh Thanh Commune. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and causes abrupt high fever, headache, myalgias, and nausea; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, drowsiness, or cold limbs. Seek prompt medical care; avoid home treatment with aspirin or ibuprofen due to bleeding risk. Preventive measures include removing standing water, covering containers, cleaning, larval control, bed nets, long clothing, and repellents. Dengue vaccination is available for 4+, two-dose schedule of 3 months apart via Long Chau; WHO’s TAK-003 is recommended for 6–16-year-olds in high transmission areas, with local licensing separate. Vaccination reduces risk but does not guarantee protection and does not replace vector control.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Tightens Ebola Travel Rules, Threatens Sanctions on Non‑Compliant Airlines
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightened Ebola travel rules on 19 November, expanding screening at Entebbe Airport and mandating a passenger locator form to bolster contact tracing. Airlines and other transport operators face sanctions for knowingly transporting passengers without proper authorisation or required documents; cross-border movement via unauthorized routes carries penalties. Ugandan nationals returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo must undergo health assessments and complete a 21-day quarantine or monitored isolation. Humanitarian workers require prior approval from the Director General of Health Services to cross the border, and the movement of bodies into or out of Uganda now requires authorisation. Mass gatherings in high-risk border districts are suspended until further notice, with organisers needing health ministry clearance. Tightened monitoring targets schools, hotels and communities, including guest-record verification. Uganda remains Ebola-free since 27 August after a 42-day monitoring period; last patient discharged 16 July. Kenya reports open borders.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Workers pull dozens of dead pigs floating on the North Canal in Thanh Hóa.
article.articleSummary: 63 dead pigs and numerous bags of waste have been retrieved from Thanh Hóa Province’s Bắc Canal since early November, along the Quy Xa Dam in Thiệu Trung commune, with carcasses dumped either whole or in sacks and many decayed. Song Chu Ltd’s irrigation unit has organized environmental cleanup and alerted authorities to identify the dumping sources and enforce penalties. Local officials say some carcasses originated elsewhere and drifted into the canal. Given ASF dynamics, improper disposal could disseminate pathogens and threaten livelihoods. By mid-November, Thanh Hóa reports 13 of 30 communes/wards have ended ASF outbreaks; 17 remain affected (not yet past 21 days), impacting 104 hamlets. Authorities urge stronger inspections and public awareness on proper disposal of dead animals and waste.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Bans Mass Gatherings in Ebola-Prone Border Districts, Tightens Cross-Border Controls
article.articleSummary: Uganda bans mass gatherings in 34 high-risk border districts to curb importation of Ebola Virus Disease from the Democratic Republic of Congo, effective immediately after the November 19, 2026 announcement. Concerts, festivals, rallies and other events require written clearance; cross-border movement, including ungazetted points, is restricted. Returning Ugandans from DRC face mandatory health risk assessments and a 21-day quarantine or monitored self-isolation; humanitarian workers require prior clearance; the movement of bodies is prohibited without authorization. Entebbe International Airport implements screening, with passenger locator forms and sanctions for unauthorised travellers. New arrivals and relocations to high-risk districts must report to Local Council I; day scholars from the DRC are prohibited, with boarding students undergoing 21 days of quarantine. Hotels must maintain guest registers and verify IDs. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or body fluids; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea and unexplained bleeding; report suspected cases promptly.

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Meningitis Meningokokus, Kenali Tanda Bahaya dan Cara Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of meningococcal meningitis: recognize the warning signs and how it is transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, often begins like flu and can rapidly progress to meningitis of the brain and spinal cord. In those over two years, warning signs include sudden high fever, neck stiffness, severe headache, nausea or vomiting, photophobia, confusion, seizures, drowsiness, and loss of appetite; in newborns and toddlers, fever, persistent crying, poor feeding, stiff body or neck, vomiting, and a bulging fontanelle. Transmission starts in the upper respiratory tract and can spread through the bloodstream to the meninges. Teens and young adults are at higher risk, with outbreaks more likely in crowded settings such as dormitories, boarding schools, military bases, and daycare centers. Early antibiotic treatment is critical for bacterial meningitis; vaccination reduces risk, and close contacts should seek antibiotic prophylaxis even if already vaccinated.
