article.articleHeadline: 我国科学家揭开斯氏按蚊更能传播疟疾的秘密
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese scientists uncover why Anopheles stephensi is more capable of transmitting malaria.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 November 2026, Chinese researchers report that urban-adapted malaria vector Anopheles stephensi has acquired a large deletion in the timeless (tim) circadian clock gene, enabling enhanced heat tolerance and malaria transmission. In a study, colonies were reared for about 80 generations at 32°C day/30°C night; the frequency of a ~5 kb deletion in tim rose from 2.08% in standard-temperature mosquitoes to 28.65% under heat selection. Homozygous tim deletions severely disrupt mating due to circadian chaos; heterozygous males retain clock stability and gain 3.6–4.7× mating competitiveness under heat, bolstering gene spread. Crucially, females carrying the mutation exhibit reduced malaria resistance, while infection rates climbed from 74% to 97.5% and parasite load increased, under laboratory exposure to malignant malaria parasites. The work links clock-gene variation to heat adaptation and elevated malaria transmission, with implications for urban malaria control amid climate warming across South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者がAnopheles stephensiがより多くの疟疾を伝播できる理由を明らかにした
triage.triage_reason: 疟疾媒介蚊の生物学的特性に関する研究報告であり、異常な疾病発生ではなく科学的知見の報告である。国際的な公衆衛生への潜在的影響があるが、現在の発生事例ではないため情報経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は疟疾の実際の流行ではなく、媒介蚊Anopheles stephensiの遺伝子変異に関する中国の科学的研究報告である。記事は気候変動下での南アジア、中東、アフリカにおける都市疟疾制御への今後の影響について言及しているが、現在の活動的な感染症イベントではない。媒介蚊の熱適応能と疟疾伝播能向上に関する知見は中期的な公衆衛生リスクの観点から注視する価値があるが、緊急シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mandaue checks private lot near school amid dengue cases, deaths
article.articleSummary: Two dengue-related deaths in November 2026 in Mandaue City's Opao area, including kindergarten pupils, with 15 additional confirmed dengue cases within Opao Elementary School. Authorities suspect a private lot beside the school as a mosquito breeding ground; ownership is unclear and access is restricted by a security guard, hindering inspection. Mayor Thadeo Jovito Ouano inspected Barangays Umapad and Opao on November 19, 2026, as city officials conducted misting and cleanup drives on November 17–18. The Department of Education requested another misting round; dengue fast lanes were opened, and the city extended financial aid to affected families. Officials stress disease prevention and keeping surroundings clean, aiming to determine the infection source and address a possible school-related cluster.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市、デング熱の感染・死亡例を受け学校近くの民有地を調査
triage.triage_reason: 学校関連のデング熱クラスターで死亡例が発生し、発生源（蚊の繁殖地）が未特定・未対処のまま住民・児童への曝露が継続しており、地元行政・教育当局が積極的に対応している社会的関心の高い事案。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節性の風土病であり国際的な異常性・拡大リスクは低いが、学校関連クラスターと死亡例、蚊の繁殖源対応の遅れが懸念材料。地域限定の公衆衛生対応事案として続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: 40 students fall ill after food at UoH, student steps in to drive ambulance
article.articleSummary: Forty students at the University of Hyderabad's Men’s Hostel M, Annex and NRS hostels fell ill after meals on Nov 19, 2026. Affected individuals reported symptoms such as uneasiness and vomiting, with some cases following poha at breakfast, fried vegetables at lunch, and rajma rice at dinner. The incident occurred around 10:30 pm, with authorities noting deteriorating health through the night. Three ambulances were deployed; two drivers initially, with a student driving the third ambulance to transport peers to the university health centre, where patients began receiving treatment and were discharged after medication. The deputy chief warden assessed the situation at 1 am and the health centre intake began at 2:45 am. The report does not mention laboratory confirmation of a specific pathogen, nor an identified source beyond meals at campus hostels.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード大学で学生40人が食事後に体調不良、学生が救急車を運転して搬送
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での食中毒疑いの集団発生であり、病原体不明だが国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められず、公衆衛生上の重大性も限定的である。
triage.notes: 大学寮での食事後の集団体調不良（嘔吐等）で、食中毒の疑いが強いが検査による病原体特定の報告はなし。全員が治療後に退院しており、重症例や死亡の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: BioVersys reports results from Phase 2a ENABLE study for tuberculosis treatments containing AlpE
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis treated with AlpE (alpibectir + ethionamide) plus rifampicin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol (RZE) showed early bactericidal activity over 14 days in a Phase 2a ENABLE study of newly diagnosed drug-sensitive TB. In regimens replacing isoniazid with ethionamide, AlpE at 45 mg with 250 mg ethionamide produced EBA numerically similar to standard HRZE, with ethionamide showing dose-dependent activity (250 mg > 125 mg). AlpE was generally well tolerated, indicating potential to simplify and improve TB regimens. The trial (NCT06748937) is part of the EU IHI JU UNITE4TB program, with results presented at the Union World Conference on Lung Health (Nov 17–20, 2026) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. An ongoing Phase 2b STEP2C study in six African countries (first-patient-first-visit March 2026) evaluates AlpE-RZE, and a TB meningitis program is advancing. AlpE originated from collaboration among Pasteur Institute Lille, BioVersys, and GSK.

triage.headline_ja: BioVersys社、AlpEを含む結核治療薬のフェーズ2a ENABLE試験の結果を報告
triage.triage_reason: 新薬治験の臨床結果報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとして取り扱わない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核治療薬の臨床試験（フェーズ2a/2b）結果報告であり、特定国での感染拡大事象ではない。発生地域にBrazil・Franceが含まれるが、これらは会議開催地・研究機関所在地であり、感染症発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 全国流感活动整体进入中流行水平，流行毒株以甲型为主
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide influenza activity has entered a moderate level of circulation, with Influenza A as the predominant circulating strain.
article.articleSummary: China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention reports for the week of November 9–15, 2026, nationwide acute respiratory infection surveillance shows most regions in the high season for respiratory illnesses with influenza activity at a moderate level. Influenza A is the predominant strain; detection includes known pathogens only, with no unknown or novel pathogens identified. The main circulating pathogens are influenza viruses and rhinovirus; rhinovirus positivity has fluctuated downward, while human metapneumovirus positivity is rising. Other respiratory pathogens remain at low levels. Recommendations emphasize proactive vaccination for high-risk groups (pregnant women, young children, older adults, and individuals with chronic diseases), plus multisector prevention: proper hand hygiene, covering coughs/sneezes, avoiding touching the face, wearing masks in crowded places, maintaining good ventilation, and seeking medical care for fever or respiratory symptoms as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 全国のインフルエンザ活動が中程度の流行レベルに達し、流行株はA型が主流
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ・既知病原体による通常の流行報告であり、新規・異常な病原体は確認されていない。公的機関による定例サーベイランス情報で、社会的関心や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（インフルエンザA型、ライノウイルス、ヒトメタニューモウイルス）による通常の流行状況報告であり、新規病原体の検出なし。中国疾病予防管理センターによる定例サーベイランス情報。

article.articleHeadline: 14 Students Fall Ill Due to Suspected Food Poisoning at Kakatiya University
article.articleSummary: Fourteen students at Kakatiya University in Hanamkonda fell ill after consuming food alleged to have gone bad, in what is described as suspected food poisoning. The incident prompted protests outside the university's main gate, with students demanding improved food quality and hygiene in campus dining facilities. No laboratory confirmation or official health status details are provided in the report, and the current condition of the affected students is unclear. University authorities' response and any further health investigations are not reported. The article notes ongoing student concerns about food quality and dining hygiene on campus, with further details awaited as of 20 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: カカティヤ大学で学生14人が食中毒疑いで体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒疑いの局所的事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いの単発事例で、学生による抗議活動が起きているが公衆衛生上の重大性や感染性の懸念は低い。続報があれば再評価。

article.articleHeadline: Ruptured Pulmonary Cystic Echinococcosis May Require Pneumonectomy: A Case
article.articleSummary: Ruptured pulmonary cystic echinococcosis requiring pneumonectomy in a 26-year-old Tibetan herdsman. A two-week history of cough, sputum, and intermittent fever preceded imaging, which showed left hydropneumothorax with detached parasitic membranes, substantial left-lung collapse, and bilateral opacities. Thoracentesis was performed. Thoracotomy revealed purulent pleural fluid and an extensive fibrous peel surrounding the collapsed lung; a ruptured hydatid cyst measuring roughly 25 by 20 cm, along with significant parenchymal loss and multiple bronchopleural communications, was identified. Surgical management included left pneumonectomy, hydatid cyst removal, fibrous peel stripping, and empyema cavity debridement. Histopathology confirmed pulmonary cystic echinococcosis. The patient was discharged with a functioning chest drainage tube, removed at one-month outpatient follow-up. The authors note that spontaneous cyst rupture into the pleural cavity can cause severe pleural infection and extensive destruction, and when lung-sparing resections are precluded, operative extent must be guided by anatomy and tissue viability, rather than convention.

triage.headline_ja: 破裂した肺嚢胞性エキノコックス症が肺全摘術を要した一例報告
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、人獣共通感染症（エキノコックス症）の個別症例であるため感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bareilly News: छह साल से बरेली में ग्लैंडर्स का नया मामला नहीं, तीन घोड़ों की गई थी जान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bareilly News: No new case of glanders in Bareilly for six years; three horses died.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 November 2026, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, reports no new glanders cases in horses for six years. The zoonotic bacterial disease was first confirmed in 2019 in three horses from Rithora, Bhojipura, and Sardar Nagar, after which the infected animals were euthanized. To curb spread, Bithri Chainpur and Bhojipura were designated sensitive zones, with horse blood samples sent to a Hisar laboratory for testing. In 2023, 64 samples were dispatched for analysis, and ongoing surveillance continues. No additional positives have been recorded to date. Chief Veterinary Officer Dr. Manmohan Pandey warns that glanders can spread to humans and urges farmers to report suspected symptoms promptly. In horses, nasal discharge, difficulty breathing, lung nodules, and skin lesions are the primary signs.

triage.headline_ja: バレイリーニュース：6年間ベレイリーで新たな鼻疽の症例なし、過去に馬3頭が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 6年間新規症例なしという経過報告であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 2019年に確認された鼻疽の過去事例に関する経過報告であり、新規感染拡大の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Los pasajeros y tripulantes de dos vuelos, en alerta por un pasajero con sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Passengers and crew of two flights on alert due to a passenger with measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles exposure on two Thai Airways international flights prompted a health alert in Australia and Thailand. Thailand's Department of Communicable Disease Control urged passengers and crew seated near 46D on TG340 (Dhaka to Bangkok) and near 36D on TG475 (Bangkok to Sydney) to monitor for measles symptoms for 21 days after exposure, through November 28. The infected traveler traveled from Dhaka, Bangladesh to Sydney via Bangkok, landed in Sydney at 21:10, and later attended Canterbury Hospital in Campsie on November 8, triggering New South Wales health notification under the International Health Regulations. Symptoms to watch include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash. The alert coincides with a severe measles outbreak in Bangladesh, with over 50,000 cases and at least 350 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹患者搭乗により2便の乗客・乗員に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち『深刻な公衆衛生影響』と『国際的拡大リスク』の2項目に該当し、国際便を介した麻疹曝露事案としてフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本事案はバングラデシュでの大規模麻疹流行（5万例以上、死亡350例以上）を背景に、感染者がダッカ→バンコク→シドニー間のタイ国際航空便に搭乗していたことが発端。タイは経由地としてのみ関与し、現地での発生確認はないが、同国保健当局がIHRに基づき公式に警戒情報を発出しているため、記事主題国として含めた。バングラデシュ・オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bioversys: Phase-2a-Studie zeigt Wirksamkeit bei Tuberkulose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bioversys: Phase 2a study shows efficacy in tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Phase IIa study in drug-susceptible pulmonary tuberculosis shows that all 14-day regimens including Alpe produced early bactericidal activity in newly diagnosed patients. Alpe alone and in combination with rifampicin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol demonstrated early bacterial kill, with the Alpe–rifampicin–pyrazinamide–ethambutol combo achieving efficacy comparable to standard therapy. Alpe was generally well tolerated with an acceptable safety profile. Data were presented at the Union World Conference on Lung Health in Rio de Janeiro, 17–20 November 2026. Bioversys plans to advance Alpe in a Phase IIb Step2c study evaluating the first two months of treatment across six African countries, and separately for tuberculous meningitis. Alpe is not yet approved, but has orphan-drug status in the USA since 2023 and in the EU since 2025; development is in collaboration with GlaxoSmithKline.

triage.headline_ja: Bioversys社:フェーズ2a試験で結核に対する有効性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 新薬の臨床試験結果に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や発生拡大を示すものではない。発生地域は学会開催地(リオデジャネイロ)であり実際の疾病発生とは無関係。
triage.notes: 記事は結核治療薬Alpeの第2a相試験結果を報告する医薬品開発ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生情報ではない。発生地域として挙げられたブラジル(リオデジャネイロ)は学会開催地に過ぎず、疾病の実発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmados 12 casos de SIDA nos primeiros nove meses do ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Twelve AIDS cases confirmed in the first nine months of the year.
article.articleSummary: Macau has 295 confirmed HIV cases among residents since 2015 through September 2026, with 12 new infections in the first nine months of 2026, below the 10-year average of 26 annually. About 62% of cases are aged 20–39, and 62.7% of transmissions occur among men who have sex with men; no needle-sharing transmission has been recorded since 2015. HIV/AIDS shows a downward trend since 2020. Methadone treatment reached 88 recipients, with 80% attendance, aligning with WHO norms. Authorities emphasize interdepartmental collaboration for prevention, with ongoing HIV screening efforts by the Institute of Social Action (IAS) and Health Services (SSM). Co-infection risk with hepatitis C is acknowledged; 40 HCV-infected individuals have been referred to Conde de São Januário Hospital for treatment and follow-up. Educational authorities will expand sexual education, launching an Academy for Parents and a family-focused social media page.

triage.headline_ja: 今年最初の9ヶ月でエイズ症例12件確認
triage.triage_reason: HIV/AIDS症例数は過去10年平均を下回り減少傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。通常の疫学報告の範囲内である。
triage.notes: マカオ（中国特別行政区）の定例HIV/AIDS統計報告であり、新規感染数は減少傾向。シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia Begins Construction of $213 Million Cholera Vaccine Manufacturing Plant
article.articleSummary: Zambia launched construction of ZAMVAX, its first cholera vaccine manufacturing plant in Lusaka South, a $213 million joint venture (IDC 60%, Jijia International Medical Technology 40%). The initial phase ($24.1 million) will establish a fill-and-finish facility with ~20 million oral cholera vaccine doses capacity, using imported bulk antigens at first, with local antigen production planned later for end-to-end manufacturing. The project aims to reduce import dependence, serve regional markets, and support Africa’s goal to eliminate cholera by 2030. Construction began November 17, two weeks after the JV agreement; groundbreaking attended by Health Minister Roma Chilengi and a Chinese official. As of November 2, 2026, Zambia’s cholera outbreak since July 28 totaled 1,958 cases (303 laboratory-confirmed) and 40 deaths across seven provinces. Regional context: five Southern African countries reported 4,320 cases and 56 deaths (Jan 1–Feb 15, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、2億1300万ドル規模のコレラワクチン製造工場の建設を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン工場建設が主題だが、ザンビアで7月28日以降1,958症例・40死亡（7州）に及ぶコレラ流行が継続中であり、南部アフリカ地域での拡大も報告されているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はワクチン製造施設の建設だが、背景情報として進行中のコレラ流行規模（7州、約2,000症例、40死亡）および地域的拡大（南部アフリカ5カ国で4,320症例・56死亡）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念材料として評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Agusan del Sur breach 4,000; deaths now 22
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections in Agusan del Sur, Philippines have breached 4,000 cases with 22 deaths as of Nov 16, 2026 (4,021 cases; 248 new infections in the latest morbidity week; case fatality rate 0.55%). Rosario town remains outbreak epicenter with 859 cases and an attack rate of 16 per 1,000. Other municipalities with high caseloads include San Francisco (543), Bayugan City (437), Loreto (425), Prosperidad (348), and Bunawan (327). The top attack-rate areas are Loreto (9 per 1,000), Bunawan (7 per 1,000), La Paz (7 per 1,000), and San Francisco (6 per 1,000). Children aged 10-14 make up 18.25% of infections; mean age is 20 years. Of 22 deaths, 12 are female and 10 male, ages 3-52; Bayugan City records 7 deaths, Rosario 5, Loreto 3, Bunawan 2, San Francisco 2, with single fatalities in Trento, Prosperidad, and Santa Josefa. PHO urges standard DOH dengue prevention and early medical intervention.

triage.headline_ja: アグサン・デル・スール州のデング熱症例が4,000件を突破、死者22人に
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン国内の一地域における季節性デング熱流行であり、死者数・症例数は増加しているが国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の兆候はなく、国内保健当局による標準的対応が継続中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はフィリピン・アグサン・デル・スール州（カラガ地方）での地域的デング熱流行を報告。発生地域にPeruやLoreto（ペルー領の可能性）が含まれるが、記事本文はフィリピンの地名（Loreto, Rosario, Bunawanなど）を指しており、Peruは主題ではないため除外。PHOがDOH標準プロトコルに基づき対応中で、外部支援の必要性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumococcal Hospitalizations Rebounded After Pandemic While Viral
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong Hospital Authority data (Jan 2015–Aug 2024) show pneumococcal hospitalizations among adults (n=5,517) declined sharply with COVID-19 non-pharmaceutical interventions and rebounded after restrictions lifted. Non-invasive pneumococcal pneumonia accounted for 4,597 of hospitalizations; invasive pneumococcal disease accounted for 920 cases, with 62.3% confirmed by blood cultures; other confirmations included CSF, pleural, joint, ocular, or peritoneal fluids. During 2015–2019 baseline, annual incidence averaged 11.0 per 100,000 person-years (n≈699/year). Pandemic period (2020–2022) saw incidences drop to 4.2–6.0 per 100,000 (271–392 admissions annually). Post-pandemic, 2023 saw 572 admissions (8.7/100k), with 2024 projected to 654 (9.9/100k). Viral coinfection with influenza or SARS-CoV-2 markedly worsened trajectories, elevating ICU admission and mortality risk. Demographic shifts included majority male and high share of patients aged ≥70, with prevalent chronic comorbidities; rebound slower than in Canada/Europe due to persistent voluntary masking in Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌による入院、パンデミック後に増加 ― ウイルス共感染がリスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: 香港における肺炎球菌入院動向に関する後方視的疫学研究であり、新規の異常事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的な後方視的データ分析であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。Canadaは比較対象として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : À Kinshasa, le recours aux seaux hygiéniques nocturnes expose les ménages aux périls des maladies hydriques - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Kinshasa, the use of night-time hygienic buckets exposes households to the dangers of waterborne diseases - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: In Kinshasa, DRC, residents rely on night-time plastic buckets as makeshift toilets, a practice that has become widespread amid urban precarity, insecurity after dark, and degraded shared sanitation. While offering immediate protection against assaults, morning handling and manual emptying of these portable toilets without proper protection transform them into potent transmission vectors for oro-fecal diseases. The threat persists as cholera and typhoid fever outbreaks loom in the country, worsened by the absence of appropriate disinfection chains at the household level. Basic barrier measures—careful handwashing and sun-drying containers—depend on regular access to potable water. The phenomenon highlights chronic gaps in urban drainage and sanitation networks, overwhelmed by rapid city growth. Long-term control requires expanding access to running water and rehabilitating public sanitation infrastructure, alongside sustained community hygiene campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：キンシャサで夜間用バケツトイレの使用が各世帯を水系感染症の危険に晒す
triage.triage_reason: コレラ・腸チフス発生のリスク要因（衛生インフラ不足）を指摘する社会構造的記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの確定情報がないため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラ・腸チフスの具体的な発生事例ではなく、キンシャサの衛生インフラ不足とそれによる水系感染症リスクの構造的問題を論じたもの。既存のコレラ流行が背景として言及されているが新規アウトブレイクの確証はない。

article.articleHeadline: BioVersys AlpE Tuberculosis Regimen Shows Dose-Dependent Activity
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis in newly diagnosed, drug-sensitive patients showed dose-dependent early bactericidal activity with AlpE (alpibectir plus ethionamide) over 14 days in the ENABLE Phase 2a study. Ethionamide activity increased with dose: 250 mg was more active than 125 mg. Regimens included AlpE alone and with RZE (rifampicin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol). AlpE 45 mg/250 mg with RZE yielded early bactericidal activity numerically similar to standard HRZE, though the trial wasn’t powered for between-arm comparisons. AlpE replaces isoniazid in HRZE, suggesting potential use for isoniazid-resistant TB and a tolerable 14-day safety profile. Results were presented at the Union World Conference on Lung Health in Rio de Janeiro (e-poster Nov 18; oral Nov 19, 2026). STEP2C will evaluate AlpE-RZE over two months in six African countries, with Stage 3 testing higher-dose AlpE regimens and relapse-free survival at 12 months as secondary endpoints.

triage.headline_ja: BioVersys社のAlpE結核治療レジメン、用量依存的な活性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 新薬の臨床試験結果に関する学術発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リオデジャネイロで開催された学会での新規結核治療薬（AlpE）の第2a相臨床試験結果発表に関するもの。疾病の発生・流行を報告するものではなく、ブラジルでの感染拡大を示すものでもない。今後STEP2C試験がアフリカ6カ国で実施予定とあるが、具体国名は不明。

article.articleHeadline: BioVersys: Tuberkulose-Wirkstoff zeigt Wirkung in Studie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BioVersys: Tuberculosis Drug Shows Efficacy in a Study
article.articleSummary: BioVersys reports that the Alpibectir and Ethionamide combination (Alpe) produced early bactericidal activity over 14 days in patients with newly diagnosed drug-susceptible pulmonary tuberculosis, in a Phase IIa ENABLE study. Alpe tested alone and in combination with rifampicin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol, with the latter regimen showing comparable efficacy to current standard therapy and a favorable safety profile. Results were presented November 17–20, 2026 at the Union World Conference on Lung Health in Rio de Janeiro. The findings support further development of Alpe as part of future TB treatments. A Phase IIb Step2c trial is evaluating Alpe during the first two months of therapy in six African countries, and a separate program is pursuing TB meningitis. Alpe is not yet approved; it has orphan drug status in the US (since 2023) and the EU (since 2025). BioVersys collaborates with GSK.

triage.headline_ja: BioVersys:結核治療薬がスタディで有効性を示す
triage.triage_reason: これは新薬開発に関する臨床試験の成果発表記事であり、感染症の発生・流行イベントではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は学会発表（ブラジル・リオデジャネイロで開催）における治験結果の報告であり、感染症の発生地を示すものではない。試験は複数のアフリカ諸国で実施予定とあるが具体国名の記載はなく、対象国リストとの一致も確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: 长期熬夜致免疫力"崩了"，19岁男生胸背部出现水疱，伴随剧痛！这种病毒进入高发期，预防至关重要
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chronic late nights have weakened his immune system; a 19-year-old man develops blisters on his chest and back with severe pain as this virus enters its peak incidence period—prevention is crucial.
article.articleSummary: Shingles (herpes zoster) diagnosed in a 19-year-old male college student in Changsha, China, after prolonged sleep deprivation and irregular meals weakened his immunity. He had left chest/back and precordial pain, followed by clustered papules and vesicles with severe neural pain, confined to one side along a dermatomal distribution. In the past month, Changsha Central Hospital dermatology saw 60+ shingles cases, with about 60% under 50, indicating a shift toward younger patients. The disease results from reactivation of varicella-zoster virus latent in dorsal root ganglia; triggers include stress, poor nutrition, and lack of exercise. Early antiviral therapy within 48–72 hours of rash onset is crucial and can shorten illness and reduce postherpetic neuralgia, especially in patients over 50. Advise non-immune individuals (pregnant women, infants, immunocompromised) to avoid direct vesicle contact; be aware of ocular, otic, and disseminated forms.

triage.headline_ja: 長期の夜更かしで免疫力が「崩壊」、19歳男性の胸背部に水疱が出現し激しい痛みを伴う！このウイルスが流行期に入り、予防が重要に
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹（水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスの再活性化）による個人の健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 帯状疱疹は水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスの再活性化による非感染性（他者への水平感染リスクは低い）疾患であり、生活習慣による若年層増加を扱う健康情報記事。ヒト-ヒト感染拡大や公衆衛生危機とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Moçambique entre países ameaçados pela cólera devido ao El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mozambique among countries threatened by cholera due to El Niño.
article.articleSummary: November 2026 Risk Bulletin by Action Against Hunger flags Mozambique among three southern African countries—Mozambique, Zambia, and Zimbabwe—for strengthened surveillance as El Niño–related conditions may heighten cholera and other waterborne disease risks. Projections warn of late, below‑average rains, prolonged drought, and above‑average temperatures that threaten safe water, agriculture, and food security. In Mozambique, conflict, displacement, and food insecurity increase malnutrition and transmissible‑disease vulnerability, especially among displaced and host communities in the north. The bulletin notes diarrheal diseases and worsening child malnutrition, urging anticipatory health, nutrition, and WASH interventions. Mozambique’s prolonged cholera epidemic (Sep 2025–Aug 2026) recorded 9,708 cases and 91 deaths, with peaks in Nampula, Tete, and Cabo Delgado; early 2026 saw >42 districts with active transmission (>100 daily cases), subsiding after rains ended in April. Cholera remains a recurrent threat due to water/sanitation gaps and climate extremes; UN anticipatory action mechanism funds preventive measures. Preparedness prioritized in southern Africa, including Mozambique.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの影響でコレラ流行の脅威に直面するモザンビークなどの国々
triage.triage_reason: モザンビークでの大規模なコレラ流行（9,708症例、91死亡）に加え、エルニーニョによる干ばつ・水不足が周辺国（ザンビア、ジンバブエ）にも拡大するリスクが指摘されており、IHR基準の深刻性・国際的拡大の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる実被害データはモザンビーク（対象国リスト外）に関するものだが、ザンビアはエルニーニョ関連のコレラリスクが高いとして名指しで監視強化対象国に挙げられているため含めた。ジンバブエは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: पलवल में तेजी से पैर पसार रहा खसरा, 11 महीने में 32 बच्चे संक्रमित; बूस्टर डोज छूटना बना वजह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles spreading rapidly in Palwal, 32 children infected in 11 months; missed booster doses cited as the reason.
article.articleSummary: Measles is spreading rapidly in Palwal district, Haryana, with 32 infections in 11 months; seven cases emerged in the last 45 days. The surge is tied to vaccination gaps and disruption of routine immunization during the COVID-19 era. Most cases are among 8–10-year-olds, many not fully immunized before 2022. Although vaccination coverage had been near 100% in recent years, delays and missed booster doses increased susceptibility. Health teams are conducting door-to-door campaigns, identifying about 30,000 children and administering both MR vaccine doses to 23,000. Shamsabad and Islamabad are the most affected areas; Hodal and Hathin also report cases. Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, white oral spots, and a red rash; severe complications can include pneumonia or brain inflammation. MR vaccine is free at government facilities, with Vitamin-A and medicines provided to infected children.

triage.headline_ja: パルワルで麻疹が急速に拡大、11カ月で子ども32人感染；ブースター接種逃しが原因
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地区（ハリヤナ州パルワル）における麻疹の局地的流行であり、ワクチン接種率の低下が原因とされるが、当局により家庭訪問接種キャンペーンが実施され管理されている。国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、流行しやすさの観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: COVID-19はキーワードとして記事に含まれるが、実際の疾患事象は麻疹（Measles）の地域的流行であり、COVID-19自体の感染拡大ではない。発生地域はハリヤナ州パルワル県（Shamsabad, Hodal, Hathinなど）に限定され、国際的拡大リスクは確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Cop31 nel vivo: Oms lancia l'allarme sanitario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COP31 in full swing: WHO issues a health warning.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns at COP31 in Antalya that climate change is a health crisis, with 3.3–3.6 billion people living in highly climate-vulnerable contexts and, in the last two decades, more than 90% of disaster deaths occurring in developing countries. The agency pushes for concrete commitments in negotiation texts and national strategies, backed by dynamic, resilient health systems. The briefing flags additional deaths between 2030 and 2050 from malnutrition, malaria, diarrheal diseases, and heat stress. Health infrastructures face elevated risk, with a 41% higher chance of damage from extreme weather since 1990. In 2023, 7.1 million deaths were attributed to ambient fine particulate pollution; 666 million lacked electricity; nearly 2 billion lacked clean cooking solutions. If action expands, up to 1.6 million lives could be saved annually, with substantial economic gains in trillions of euros. Antalya resilience initiative (started Nov 9) links COP31 to COP32 in Ethiopia and Belem Action Plan guidance.

triage.headline_ja: COP31が本格化：WHOが健康警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: 特定国での感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、COP31における気候変動と健康リスクに関するWHOの一般的な政策声明であり、マラリア等は将来予測における一例として言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOP31気候会議でのWHOによる気候変動と健康影響に関する一般的声明。マラリアは2030-2050年の将来予測における死亡要因の一例として挙げられているのみで、具体的な発生国・アウトブレイク情報ではない。ブラジル・トルコ・エチオピアは会議開催地や関連地名として登場するが、感染症発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue| Pregnant Lady| 7 மாத கர்ப்பிணி திடீர் மரணம்.. தமிழகத்திற்கே இதில் ஒரு 'எச்சரிக்கை' செய்தி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue | Pregnant Woman | 7-month pregnant woman dies suddenly.. A 'warning' message for Tamil Nadu.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 November 2026, a 7-month pregnant woman died of dengue fever in Tamil Nadu's Erode district. The patient from Velampalayam, near Modakkurichi, was treated initially at a private hospital, then admitted to Perundurai Government Medical College Hospital, and later transferred to Coimbatore Government Medical College Hospital for advanced care, where she died suddenly. Local health authorities have launched dengue prevention and sanitation campaigns in the resident area to curb transmission. The incident serves as a warning about dengue risk in Tamil Nadu, particularly for pregnant women, and underscores the need for timely medical attention and vector-control measures in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱｜妊婦｜妊娠7カ月の女性が突然死亡…タミル・ナードゥ州への「警告」メッセージ
triage.triage_reason: 単発のデング熱死亡例であり、地域的な予防対策は実施されているが大規模流行や国際的拡大の情報はなく、個別症例として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はタミル・ナードゥ州の地域風土病として既知であり、本記事は単一の重症死亡例の報告。地元当局による防除活動は開始されているが、流行拡大や症例数急増の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ lây lan bệnh truyền nhiễm khi giao mùa, nhiều bệnh viện nhi quá tải
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of infectious disease transmission during the seasonal transition; many pediatric hospitals are overwhelmed.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal transition raises pediatric infectious disease risk in Haiphong and Haiduong, Vietnam. Adenovirus and RSV drive most respiratory infections in children, with influenza and hand-foot-mouth disease adding burden. In Haiphong, the children’s hospital records about 300 outpatient visits daily and over 500 inpatients, up roughly 10% from before; many respiratory cases test positive for Adenovirus and RSV, and at times nearly one-third of respiratory inpatients at the International Treatment Unit are Adenovirus-positive. In Haiduong, the Respiratory Department at Hai Duong Children’s Hospital sees over 80 admissions daily, with around 50 inpatients, and more than half of respiratory cases are viral, mainly Adenovirus and RSV. Year-to-date, Haiphong has 6,055 influenza cases and 5,445 hand-foot-mouth cases; the International Maternity and Children’s Hospital Haiphong reported 2,994 hand-foot-mouth cases in 10 months of 2026. Public health guidance urges hygiene, staying home when ill, and seeking care for warning signs; authorities call for AI-based forecasting.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目で感染症拡大リスク、小児病院が過負荷に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の小児呼吸器感染症（RSV、アデノウイルス、インフルエンザ、手足口病）による病院負荷増加だが、例年の季節変動の範囲内とみられ、異常性や国際的拡大の証拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 季節性疾患（RSV、アデノウイルス、インフルエンザ、手足口病）の複合的な流行で、ハイフォン・ハイズオン地域の小児病院が過負荷。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなく、例年の季節性変動との区別が困難。続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: 'Cơ địa' dễ bị muỗi đốt, phòng sốt xuất huyết thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People with certain body constitutions are more prone to mosquito bites: how to prevent dengue fever?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever poses a major public health risk in Vietnam in 2026, with over 170,000 cases and 21 deaths in the first 10 months; Ho Chi Minh City reported 2,428 cases in Week 46 (9–15 Nov), up 25.7% from the prior four weeks, bringing the city’s 2026 total to 49,232; Hanoi reported hundreds of new cases. The article notes variability in how often individuals are bitten by mosquitoes, likely due to body odor and other chemical cues, not confirmed links to blood type O or skin smoothness; all individuals remain at risk for infection. Prevention combines vector control and vaccination: use licensed repellents, bed nets, long sleeves, eliminate standing water, and maintain clean environments. The dengue vaccine Qdenga, for ages 4+, uses a two-dose regimen (second dose after at least 3 months) and protects against all four serotypes (DENV-1–DENV-4); contraindications include severe allergy, significant immunosuppression, and pregnancy. Vaccination complements but does not replace mosquito control, and some individuals should consult a clinician before vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊に刺されやすい体質とは？デング熱の予防法
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱の症例数が季節的に増加している（2026年累計17万例超、死亡21例）が、記事内容は予防啓発が主眼であり、異常性や国際的拡大の明確な根拠はない。経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性に流行する風土病であり、本記事は予防・ワクチン情報を中心とした啓発記事。ホーチミン市やハノイでの症例増加は報告されているが、新規異常事態というより既知の季節的傾向の延長と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Tightens Ebola Rules for Travellers
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola rules for air travellers amid Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in DR Congo. On 19 November 2026 Entebbe Airport will strengthen screening, and passengers must file a locator form before boarding. Airlines carrying undocumented travellers face sanctions. Uganda had declared its Bundibugyo outbreak over on 28 July 2026 and, by October, reported no confirmed active cases. A flare in DR Congo prompted the new measures; Nigeria later confirmed a Bundibugyo Ebola case in Abuja on 20 October 2026 linked to travel from Uganda, with Uganda maintaining it remained Ebola-free. Late October rules require locator forms for arrivals and bar transit of DR Congo-linked travellers. Ugandan returnees from DR Congo face 21 days quarantine or monitored self-isolation; hotels must record guests and verify identities; mass gatherings are suspended in high-risk border districts pending clearance. Africa CDC cites DR Congo—11,000+ cases and 5,400 deaths; Kenya begins 42-day monitoring ending 23 December 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ流行を受け渡航者への規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ再燃によりナイジェリアへの国際伝播が確認され、複数国が渡航制限・検疫措置を強化しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）再燃が主因であり、ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCは11,000例超・死亡5,400人超と大規模流行が継続中で、国際的な越境伝播（ナイジェリア症例）が確認されている点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Perubahan Iklim Bikin Dengue Makin Mengancam, Beban Ekonomi RI Tembus Rp9 Triliun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate Change Heightens Dengue Fever Threat, Indonesia's Economic Burden Reaches Rp9 Trillion
article.articleSummary: Climate change heightens dengue fever risk in Indonesia. In 2025, the country logged 161,752 dengue cases and 673 deaths across 475 regencies/cities in 36 provinces, with fatalities in 224 regencies/cities across 31 provinces, and dengue reaching about 92% of Indonesia’s 514 regencies. Warmer temperatures, increased humidity, altered rainfall patterns, and El Niño/La Niña phenomena could accelerate Aedes aegypti breeding and virus transmission, expanding geographic reach. Systematic reviews of 2016-2025 Southeast Asian literature and a 2024 EnviroScienteae study using 2007-2017 data indicate La Niña raised dengue cases in 23 provinces (67.6%). Economic burden was estimated at $550.9 million (Rp9 trillion) in 2024, driven by over 2 million inpatient visits; direct medical costs ~Rp3 trillion; out-of-pocket ~Rp3.5 trillion; primary care visits rose from 122k to 321k, with tertiary care financing at Rp8.1 trillion (2021-2025). RAN Dengue 2026-2029 is urged, incorporating climate data, Wolbachia technology, and vaccination, backed by multi-stakeholder support.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がデング熱の脅威を増大、インドネシアの経済損失は9兆ルピアに達する
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱は従来から流行している風土病であり、本記事は気候変動と経済負担に関する年次統計・政策提言のレビュー記事であって、新規の異常な発生や急性アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年の年間統計と気候変動によるリスク増大の分析、国家行動計画（RAN Dengue 2026-2029）の提言を扱う政策・統計レビューであり、急性の異常事象ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều xác lợn chết trôi nổi trên kênh Bắc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many dead pig carcasses float on the Bac Canal.
article.articleSummary: Sixty-three pig carcasses were recovered from the Bac Canal in Thanh Hóa Province, Vietnam, over about three weeks ending mid-November 2026, with many dumped in bags along the waterway near Quy Xá Dam in Thiệu Trung commune. Workers from Song Chu Ltd. repeatedly retrieved decomposing carcasses, triggering environmental cleanup and concerns about water quality for agriculture. Officials say the carcasses originated elsewhere and were discarded into the Bac Canal; authorities are tracing sources and preparing to sanction violators under regulations. Although disposal of dead livestock has declined since 2025, improper dumping persists and challenges canal management. The Bac Canal serves production and livelihoods, so decaying animal matter risks pollution and disease spread, particularly with African swine fever (ASF) still circulating in Thanh Hóa. By mid‑November, 13 of 30 communes were ASF-free for 21 days, while 17 remained affected across 104 hamlets. Local agencies urge intensified surveillance and prompt reporting.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省バック運河に多数の豚の死骸が浮遊
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、本記事も運河への豚死骸投棄という環境・動物衛生上の問題が中心。ASFが同省内で継続的に発生している点は養豚業・貿易への影響として注視が必要だが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾患のためIHR/WPRO基準の多くは該当しないが、養豚産業への経済的影響と環境汚染（水質）リスクから地域当局は監視を強化中。人への公衆衛生リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn dịch tả lợn châu Phi, bảo đảm nguồn cung thực phẩm trước Tết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent African swine fever, ensure the food supply ahead of Tet.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) is spreading in Ninh Bình Province, Vietnam, threatening food security ahead of Tet. By 15 November 2026, ASF had been detected in 22 communes, with about 17,400 pigs culled since the start of 2026. In Xuân Trường commune, Nghĩa Xá village, a farm tested positive in early November 2026, leading to culling of 52 pigs and intensified biosecurity. In Giao Minh commune, from 26 September to 31 October 2026, ASF affected three households, with more than 2 tons of pork culled. Since 31 October no new outbreaks have been recorded, but authorities maintain strict surveillance, slaughter/transport controls, and reporting. Provincial authorities mobilize veterinary resources to the grassroots, emphasize safe restocking after quarantine and safety checks, and encourage centralized, biosecure farming to curb spread before 15 December 2026. The province’s pig herd totaled 1.152 million at end-October, down 1.2% year-on-year.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱の拡大防止、テト前の食料供給を確保
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり人への健康影響はないが、食料供給・経済への影響があり、ベトナム国内での拡大が続いているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本疾患は動物(豚)のみに感染するASFであり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクはない。ただし食料安全保障・経済的影響の観点から地域当局が対応を強化しており、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。発生地域はNinh Bình省が主体だが、提供データのロケーション情報はLâm Đồng省など異なる地域を示しており、記事本文とは不一致がある点に留意。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Geospatial Surveillance Strains to Advance Indonesia's Malaria
article.articleSummary: Malaria geospatial surveillance in Indonesia remains limited in analytical depth. A Jakarta stakeholder consultation, reported in Malaria Journal, notes that despite expanded georeferenced data from SISMAL (malaria), SILANTOR (vectors), and SIARVI (arboviruses), public health teams mostly use basic mapping and underuse spatiotemporal clustering, hotspot detection, and ecological modeling. The three-day GIS training involving 25 representatives from the National Malaria Program, sub-national programs, and disease control units aimed to advance capacity with R-based spatial routines. Key barriers include technical capacity gaps (low exposure to QGIS and R, high staff turnover), unreliable internet, insufficient servers and hardware, data quality issues (completeness, timeliness, coordinate precision), and lack of standardized high-resolution boundary shapefiles. Administrative changes (e.g., Papua province boundary shifts in 2022) complicate comparability. Fragmentation across parallel databases and limited interoperability (SISMAL linked to SILANTOR) impede cross-program analyses and integrated risk assessment; SATUSEHAT integration remains incomplete.

triage.headline_ja: 地理空間サーベイランスの強化によりインドネシアのマラリア撲滅戦略を推進
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染症発生や異常事態の報告ではなく、マラリアサーベイランス体制の技術的課題と能力強化研修に関する学術的報告であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア発生そのものではなく、インドネシアにおけるGISを用いたサーベイランス能力構築研修とデータ統合の課題に関する報告。Papua New Guineaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なし（Papua州はインドネシア領として言及）のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola crisis deepens as WHO maintains international emergency
article.articleSummary: WHO maintains the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, warning infections and deaths continue to rise amid insecurity, funding shortages, and difficulties reaching affected communities. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is Congo's largest on record and the second-largest globally, with over 11,300 infections and about 5,500 deaths since May 15. Weekly new infections are roughly 400–500. Ituri province, including Bunia, remains the epicenter amid ongoing violence hindering containment. Two-thirds of confirmed deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centers; children account for more than a quarter of infections and about one-third of deaths. Two experimental vaccines ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469 will enter Phase 2 trials in Bunia around Nov 26–27. No approved vaccines or specific treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機が深刻化、WHOは国際的緊急事態を維持
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持する大規模エボラ流行であり、感染者1万1300人超、死者5500人に達し、治安悪化や資金不足で対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を維持していること、コンゴ史上最大・世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行であること、治安問題で対応が困難であることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: В Южной Корее выявили первый случай заражения холерой с 2016 года
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In South Korea, the first case of cholera since 2016 has been detected.
article.articleSummary: First cholera case detected in South Korea since 2016. As of 20 November 2026, South Korea has reported its first cholera infection in about a decade. The brief dispatch comes from Hong Kong and cites the Associated Press via Interfax; no specifics are provided on the case’s location within South Korea, clinical details, laboratory confirmation, or exposure source. The text does not mention the number of cases, deaths, or whether the infection is imported or locally acquired, nor any public health response or containment steps. The report highlights the rarity of cholera in the country over the past ten years, with no additional information available in the cited source. Readers are directed to AP reporting as the basis of the information, via Interfax.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国で2016年以来初のコレラ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 10年ぶりのコレラ症例確認という異常性はあるが、感染経路・重症度・公衆衛生対応など詳細情報が全く不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は香港発のAP通信経由の短報で、事例の発生地域（韓国内のどこか）、臨床詳細、検査確認、感染源、症例数・死亡者数、輸入例か国内感染かなどが一切不明。韓国・香港・中国はいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした（香港・中国は情報発信元であり発生国ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de São Paulo realiza semana de mobilização contra a dengue e o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo conducts a week-long mobilization against dengue and Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State Health Secretariat launches a week-long mobilization to intensify Aedes aegypti control across the state, running Monday, 23 November to Friday, 27 November, with a Day D mobilization on Saturday, 28 November. A webinar broadcast live on SES-SP’s CCD YouTube channel will detail the urban arboviruses panorama, discuss chikungunya updates, and present monitoring technologies. Participants include Leiliane Mota, director of the Dengue, Chikungunya and Zika Division; physician Carlos Brito; and Ricardo Passos, technical consultant to the Ministry of Health. In 2026, São Paulo has recorded 64,998 confirmed dengue cases and 45 dengue-related deaths. Despite declines versus last year, health officials warn the mosquito remains active and control efforts must continue year-round. Residents are advised to inspect backyards and outdoor areas, remove standing-water containers, keep water tanks sealed, clear gutters, and properly dispose of unused items. Regional data are available on the state health dashboard.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、デング熱とネッタイシマカ対策の啓発週間を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジル・サンパウロ州で地域流行している既知の媒介蚊感染症で、症例数は前年より減少傾向にあり、本記事は定例の啓発キャンペーンの告知であるため、突発的な異常事態とは言えないが継続的な観察は必要。
triage.notes: 2026年にサンパウロ州で確定デング熱症例64,998件、関連死45件が報告されているが、前年より減少傾向。記事は州保健局による定例の媒介蚊対策啓発週間の告知であり、新規の異常発生を示すものではない。チクングニア熱・ジカ熱についても言及されているが、具体的な症例増加等の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Il verme coreano che usi come esca può invadere il Mediterraneo? In Spagna è già successo | Il Giornale dei Marinai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Korean worm you use as bait could invade the Mediterranean? It has already happened in Spain | Il Giornale dei Marinai.
article.articleSummary: An Asian live-bait worm sold in Italy as the 'Korean worm' has become invasive in the Mediterranean, with Spain the first documented hotspot. The worms belong to Perinereis; taxonomic confusion means baits labeled P. aibuhitensis may actually include Perinereis linea. In 2013, a stable P. linea population was described in Spain’s Mar Menor (Murcia), the first documented outside its Pacific Northwest range, with active reproduction likely via live-bait. The Mar Menor’s high salinity (42–47‰) and wide temperature range (11–31°C) illustrate how such habitats may favor establishment as the Mediterranean warms. Import data indicate large scales: Portugal imported tens of millions of polichetes in 2002–2003 (from China and the US); in Catalonia, non-native live baits exceeded 40% in Cap de Creus (2011) and included P. linea; Japan imported 90% of 620 million live animals in 2003 as bait. Disease risks include WSSV in shrimp and Vibrio cholerae linked to Namalycastis rhodochorde in Maryland.

triage.headline_ja: エサとして使われる韓国ワームが地中海に侵入する可能性？スペインでは既に発生
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は外来種ワーム（Perinereis linea）の地中海への生態学的侵入に関する内容であり、コレラ菌への言及はごく一部の背景情報に過ぎず、ヒトの感染症アウトブレイクイベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は外来種の環境侵入（生態学的リスク）であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではない。Vibrio choleraeへの言及はメリーランド州における別種生物との関連に関する付随的情報であり、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DOH monitors monkey-linked malaria cases in Northern Palawan
article.articleSummary: As of 20 November 2026, the DOH in Mimaropa is monitoring monkey-borne Plasmodium knowlesi malaria in northern Palawan, focused on Roxas and San Vicente. The Research Institute for Tropical Medicine has validated four to five cases in Roxas and 10 cases in San Vicente. Plasmodium knowlesi originates in monkeys and is transmitted to humans via Anopheles mosquitoes; there is no documented human-to-human transmission. Heightened vigilance is warranted due to Palawan's proximity to Malaysia, where knowlesi malaria is documented. The DOH is coordinating with the WHO and Pilipinas Shell Foundation Inc., alongside veterinary experts and the DENR, to gather data on monkey populations and transmission risk. Additional surveillance is planned for Puerto Princesa City around the second week of January, in collaboration with the City Health Office.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、パラワン北部で猿由来マラリア症例を監視
triage.triage_reason: P. knowlesi（サル由来マラリア）の症例がパラワン北部で確認され、WHOとの連携調査が進行中だが、症例数は少なく人-人感染も報告されていないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: Plasmodium knowlesiは動物由来（サル媒介）でAnopheles蚊を介して感染し、人-人感染は確認されていない。マレーシアとの近接性から警戒が強化されているが、マレーシア国内での新規発生は報告されていないためMalaysiaはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta viral: o que explica o aumento recente dos casos de covid-19 no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Alert: What Explains the Recent Rise in COVID-19 Cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity is rising in Brazil, with 17 states and the Federal District showing increases. The positivity rate rose from 1% to 17% over three months, and Fiocruz reported more hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory syndrome caused by SARS-CoV-2. The dominant lineage is variant XFG (Stratus), a descendant of Omicron, responsible for about 90% of samples analyzed by the Health Ministry’s genomic surveillance. Greater transmissibility and climate factors—rain and cooler temperatures in São Paulo—appear to drive spread. However, hospitalizations remain low and not stressing the health system. A study finds the variant continues to evolve but is not more severe nor more capable of escaping vaccines. Through Nov 9, 2026, Brazil reported 118,920 COVID-19 episodes, 3,641 severe cases, and 445 deaths; 68% of deaths were among those over 65. Common symptoms include fever, malaise, congestion, sore throat, hoarseness, and voice changes; most recover within a week. Vaccination remains crucial for older adults; unvaccinated individuals should get vaccinated, while those under 60 with no comorbidities and already vaccinated do not need another dose.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス警報：ブラジルにおける最近のCOVID-19症例増加の背景
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統（XFG/Stratus）による季節性の感染者増加であり、重症度の増加や医療逼迫は見られず、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも強く該当しない。
triage.notes: 変異株XFG(Stratus)は既存のオミクロン系統で、重症度や免疫逃避の増加は確認されていない。入院数は増加傾向だが医療システムへの負荷には至っておらず、季節的要因（降雨・気温低下）による感染拡大と分析されている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en Ituri: suspension des activités sanitaires dans l'aire de santé de Lwemba | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in Ituri: suspension of health activities in the Lwemba health area | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with health activities suspended in Lwemba health area (Mambasa territory) since 16 November 2026 due to rising cases and deaths and threats against health workers. Community deaths include health professionals, some still hospitalized. The suspension follows intimidation and assaults during dignified burials and contact tracing, underscoring security challenges that hamper the response; the WHO reports more than 80 attacks on health services since the outbreak began. In Tshopo province, care activities in Bafwasende have paused for over three weeks; a health worker was killed on 24 October and an Ebola Treatment Center was attacked on 31 October. Epidemiologically, Mandima zone shows 627 cumulative EVD cases, 445 deaths, 182 active (fatality 70.9%) as of 16 November. Authorities note a decline in positives in Ituri, particularly Mambasa, with 14 current cases, down from about 20 in the prior three weeks.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：ルウェンバ保健地域で保健活動を停止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率70.9%と極めて高く、保健従事者への襲撃により対応活動が停止するなど深刻な公衆衛生上・治安上の問題が発生している。WHOも80件以上の医療従事者への攻撃を報告しており、国際的な関心・支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: マンディマ地域での累計症例627件、死亡445件、致死率70.9%という非常に深刻な数値に加え、保健従事者への攻撃・殺害による活動停止が複数地域（イツリ州ルウェンバ、ツショピ州バフワセンデ）で発生しており、治安面の課題がアウトブレイク対応を著しく阻害している。既知の継続中アウトブレイクだが、治安悪化による新たな局面として重要視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Food Safety Concerns Mount at University of Hyderabad After 30 Students Fall Ill
article.articleSummary: More than 30 students fell ill after dinner at Men’s Hostel M, Annex and NRS hostels in the University of Hyderabad, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana, prompting relocation to the university health centre. The illness, described as a food poisoning-like condition, raised concerns over hostel mess hygiene and food quality. The Dean of Student Welfare visited the health centre around 2:45 am as students urged improved medical care, continuation of a medical camp, and relaxation of exam schedules for those affected. The Students’ Union demanded a permanent nutrition officer, regular food inspections across hostel messes, upgraded health-centre infrastructure, and greater manpower in hostel kitchens. A comparable November 2024 incident at Osmania University PG College, Secunderabad involved three students with burnt khichdi and protests over food quality. Recurring campus incidents highlight gaps in food-safety monitoring, prompting calls for stronger mess inspections and nutritional monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード大学で学生30人が体調不良、食品安全への懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒様症状による単発の学内集団発生であり、病原体不明・国際的拡大の可能性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いの学内集団発生で、感染症としてのヒト-ヒト感染リスクは認められない。地域の学内衛生問題として扱われるべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: 聖嬰現象助長東南亞野火 印尼碳排創歷史第三高釀跨國公衛危機 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño fuels wildfires in Southeast Asia; Indonesia's carbon emissions reach the third-highest on record, triggering a transnational public health crisis - OwlNews
article.articleSummary: El Niño-driven wildfires in Southeast Asia push Indonesia's fire emissions to 200 million tonnes by Nov 15, 2026, according to Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service. Across Indonesia, burned area exceeds 88,000 square kilometers, with smoke wafting to Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines, triggering a regional public health crisis. Health data from Indonesia show wildfire-related respiratory infections surpassing 400,000, and more than 5,250 deaths; air quality deteriorates since September, straining healthcare, transport, and regional supply chains. The fires are fueled by prolonged drought and peatland smoldering under El Niño, worsened by global warming. Ecological losses are severe: a systematic review reports up to 94% of Southeast Asian primates facing extinction risk; in Kutai National Park, East Kalimantan, Meyer's gray leaf monkey may be extinct locally, while the Proboscis monkey reappeared after the 1997-1998 fires only after 18 years. Scientists urge peatland restoration and reduced fragmentation to bolster resilience.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが東南アジアの森林火災を助長、インドネシアの炭素排出量は観測史上3番目の高さに達し、国境を越えた公衆衛生危機を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの大規模森林火災による煙害で40万件超の呼吸器感染症と5,250人超の死亡が報告され、煙害がシンガポール・マレーシア・フィリピンにも及び地域的な公衆衛生危機となっているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症そのものではなく、エルニーニョ起因の森林火災による煙害が原因の呼吸器疾患増加・死亡事例であり、環境要因による公衆衛生危機として評価。シンガポール・マレーシアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nagy változás állt be a fertőzések számánál, ennyien betegedtek meg Szabolcsban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There has been a major change in the number of infections; this many people have fallen ill in Szabolcs.
article.articleSummary: Week 45 (Nov 2–8, 2026) infection data from the National Public Health Institute show shifting patterns in Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg County, Hungary. A mass territorial gastroenteritis outbreak began in Zala County on Nov 4, with 1495 exposed and 373 ill (mild diarrhea and vomiting); eight patient stool samples await lab confirmation, and four samples yielded Bacillus cereus in the NÉBIH lab. The preliminary assessment points to a multifood, multi‑step food safety problem; the investigation is ongoing. Three imported dengue fever cases were reported, linked to travel in Asia: two in Győr-Moson-Sopron (a 30-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman who were in Vietnam) and one in Pest County (a 35-year-old woman who had been in the Maldives). In Hajdú-Bihar, local infections included Campylobacteriosis 9, Salmonella 9, Rotavirus 1, Viral hepatitis 6, Hepatitis A 6, Scarlet fever 4, and Varicella 4; national totals are 133, 62, 35, 40, 31, 38, and 82 respectively.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者数に大きな変化があり、サボルチュ県でこれだけの人が発症しました
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリー国内の定例感染症サーベイランスレポートであり、食中毒アウトブレイクと輸入デング熱症例（渡航歴はベトナム・モルディブ）が含まれるが、いずれも対象国での発生ではなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例はベトナム・モルディブへの渡航歴による輸入症例であり、実際の発生地はハンガリー（対象国リスト外）。胃腸炎アウトブレイクもハンガリー国内の食品安全問題であり、対象国に該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Trạm tin chiều 20/11: TPHCM tăng cường phòng chống sốt xuất huyết | Siết quản lý tàu cá và xử lý vi phạm IUU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Evening News Update 20/11: Ho Chi Minh City strengthens dengue fever prevention and control | Tightening oversight of fishing vessels and addressing IUU violations.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports ongoing dengue fever outbreak in 2026. Nationwide, more than 170,000 dengue cases and 21 deaths were recorded in the first ten months. Ho Chi Minh City (TPHCM) is experiencing rising dengue activity: week 46 (Nov 9–15, 2026) saw 2,428 cases, up 25.7% from the four-week average; cumulative cases in the city since the start of the year reached 49,232 by the end of week 46. Health authorities urge residents to intensify mosquito control, including eliminating standing water, removing water-holding containers, and taking measures to prevent mosquito bites to curb transmission. The data indicate a continued dengue outbreak risk in southern Vietnam, underscoring the need for ongoing public health interventions at local and national levels.

triage.headline_ja: 夕方ニュース速報 11月20日：ホーチミン市、デング熱の予防・対策を強化｜漁船管理とIUU違反対応を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性デング熱が拡大しており症例数・死亡者数ともに増加傾向にあるが、デング熱は同地域で毎年発生する風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAよりも継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は南部ベトナムで季節性・風土病的に流行しており、国内の保健当局が対策を強化している段階。全国で17万人超・死者21人と報告数は多いが、IHR基準上の異常性・国際拡大リスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 本港增兩宗登革熱及一宗基孔肯雅熱　均為外地輸入個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports two dengue fever cases and one chikungunya fever case, all imported.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 November 2026, Hong Kong reported two imported dengue fever cases and one imported chikungunya fever case. The two dengue cases had exposure in Vietnam and Cambodia during the incubation period. The year-to-date dengue tally reaches 42 cases (40 imported, 2 local); 2025 had 59 (all imported), and 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). For chikungunya, one imported case was recorded between 13–19 November in a 71-year-old man who had travelled to Mainland China during incubation; he was hospitalized in a mosquito-free environment and remains stable, with epidemiological investigations ongoing and reported to Mainland authorities. This year Hong Kong has 9 chikungunya cases (8 imported, 1 local); in 2025 there were 82 cases (11 local, the rest imported).

triage.headline_ja: 香港でデング熱2件とチクングニア熱1件を追加報告、いずれも海外からの輸入例
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入症例の定例サーベイランス報告であり、重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも低い。
triage.notes: 症例はいずれも輸入例であり、香港（中国特別行政区）での定期的な感染症サーベイランス報告。デング熱の曝露地であるベトナム・カンボジアは、記事の主題として発生状況が述べられているわけではないため除外。チクングニア熱症例は中国本土での曝露によるもので、香港内での1例の局地感染も含むためChinaを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan Unveils Country's First Indigenous H5N1 Vaccine To Protect Chickens From Bird Flu
article.articleSummary: India's Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan unveiled the country's first indigenously developed H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens from bird flu, according to the Union Agriculture Ministry. The vaccine was developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. It is the first India-developed vaccine against the H5N1 virus of Clade 2.3.2.1a within the highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) family. The announcement frames the vaccine as a domestic countermeasure to safeguard poultry flocks from bird flu, potentially reducing economic losses from outbreaks. The article does not provide information on efficacy, trial results, manufacturing scale, dosing, or regulatory approval status, nor any details on human health implications. The focus remains on veterinary disease control and India’s biosecurity research capacity.

article.articleHeadline: Shivraj Singh Chouhan unveils India's 1st home-grown H5N1 bird flu vaccine
article.articleSummary: India unveiled its first indigenously developed H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens from bird flu, announced by Union minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal on Friday. Developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, the vaccine targets the H5N1 virus of Clade 2.3.2.1a, a highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) strain. Officials said this is India’s first-of-its-kind vaccine against H5N1 and represents a step toward self-reliance in veterinary biologics. HPAI bird flu can cause near-total mortality in affected flocks. The unveiling was attended by Madhya Pradesh ministers and other officials. The report does not mention specific case counts or outbreaks tied to this vaccine launch, but the vaccine is intended to safeguard poultry populations against future incursions of H5N1.

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu intensifica combate à dengue e terá nebulização em bairros a partir de terça-feira (24) - Acontece Botucatu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu intensifies the fight against dengue and will conduct fogging in neighborhoods starting Tuesday the 24th - Acontece Botucatu
article.articleSummary: Between Nov 23–28, Botucatu Environmental Health Surveillance (VAS) intensifies dengue and arboviruses prevention with home visits, breeding-site elimination, and a biological larvicide fogging campaign. The effort aligns with National Dengue Fight Day on Nov 28; at least 33 neighborhoods are slated to receive measures by end-2026. Vehicular nebulization using a biological larvicide begins Tuesday, Nov 24, with Monte Mor (Tue 24), Jardim Yolanda (Wed 25), Jardim Ypê (Thu 26), and Jardim Itamaraty (Fri 27) as first targets. Applications run 8:00–11:00, then 14:00–18:30, weather permitting. The larvicide targets Aedes aegypti larvae and is described as safe for humans, domestic animals, and non-target insects like bees when used correctly. October infestation index was 1.2%; Botucatu remains on alert as summer rains approach. Residents are urged to spend at least 10 minutes weekly inspecting yards, gutters, and plant containers. Call 14 3811-1609.

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu vaccine: India rolls out indigenous H5N1 jab to protect poultry
article.articleSummary: India rolled out its first indigenously developed H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens from highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). Developed by the ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal, the vaccine targets H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a and was unveiled by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal on Friday, November 20, 2026. The ministry notes this clade drives most chicken outbreaks and has been detected in other animals and in three human cases, underscoring the need to curb spread to reduce poultry losses and prevent spillover. HPAI can cause near-total mortality in infected birds. Since 2006, India has reported over 500 combined outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. The vaccine aims to bolster self-reliance and reduce transmission from poultry to other species and humans, safeguarding farmers and the broader poultry industry.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's Homegrown Push Against Bird Flu: Shivraj Singh Chouhan Launched the First Indigenous H5N1 Vaccine in Bhopal
article.articleSummary: India launched its first indigenous inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for chickens, developed by ICAR’s National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, and presented by Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan at ICAR-NIHSAD. The vaccine uses domestically produced technology and targets the highly pathogenic H5N1 virus, clade 2.3.2.1a. The rollout aims to strengthen poultry disease control, reduce production losses, and provide economic relief to farmers across the country. This marks a significant step toward self-reliance in veterinary vaccines and seeks to mitigate bird flu impacts on India’s poultry sector.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MP News: A BSL-4 lab will be built in Bhopal, ₹300 crore will be spent, Shivraj Singh Chauhan announced, the country’s first avian influenza vaccine prepared in Bhopal | MP News Shivraj Singh Chauhan Madhya Pradesh Latest News
article.articleSummary: Indigenous avian influenza vaccine developed in Bhopal by ICAR-NIHSAD (National Institute for High Security Animal Diseases) and dedicated on 20 November 2026 by former Chief Minister and Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. A BSL-4 laboratory will be built in Bhopal at an estimated cost of ₹300 crore to strengthen research and surveillance of severe pathogens. Officials credit this vaccine as a milestone for India's self-reliance, echoing the country's rapid vaccine development during the COVID-19 pandemic (two vaccines produced in nine months). The move supports the poultry sector and farmer livelihoods by reducing losses from avian influenza, aligning with India's leadership in rice and milk production and notable gains in fish production. The plan emphasizes swift scale-up of vaccine production and distribution to poultry operators and expansion of high-containment infrastructure in Madhya Pradesh.

article.articleSummary: In Bhopal, on November 20, 2026, Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan dedicated India's first indigenous H5N1 chicken vaccine to the nation to shield chickens and other birds from avian influenza. Developed domestically by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Anand Nagar, the vaccine targets highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) virus clade 2.3.2.1.A. article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn châu Phi diễn biến phức tạp, Đắk Lắk khẩn cấp ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever outbreak evolves in a complex manner; Dak Lak urgently responds.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, are escalating in a complex, high-impact pattern. From the start of 2026 through 16 November 2026, Dak Lak recorded 112 ASF outbreaks across 354 households in 167 hamlets/wards of 52 communes, with nearly 13,500 pigs affected (dead, ill, or culled) and more than 748 tonnes of pork impacted. Notably, 29 communes still have outbreaks not cleared for more than 21 days, and 9 new localities joined this category in the last 10 days. To counter the spread, the provincial government issued Directive No. 18800 on 19 November 2026, mandating unified, aggressive controls: local authorities must lead, map and isolate outbreaks, enforce sanitation, regulate transport/slaughter, and prevent movement of sick animals. The plan mobilizes Agriculture & Environment, Public Security, Border Guard, Industry & Trade, and Health to strengthen surveillance, culling, compensation, food safety, and safe restocking, with 14 hotspots receiving intensified oversight.

No case counts or human infections are reported in the article; the measure targets imported poultry meat and egg-containing products.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two outbreaks of influenza A and mumps in a school in Quảng Ninh.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November, two infectious-disease outbreaks were detected in Quảng Ninh Province, Vietnam: influenza A at Ly Thường Kiệt High School with 50 cases, and mumps at Hai Tiến Primary–Secondary School with 19 cases, both in Hải Ninh Commune, Quảng Ninh City. Local health post and school authorities implemented containment, deploying environmental decontamination with chloramine B over more than 20,000 m², focusing on classrooms and shared areas. Public-health messaging stresses hand hygiene, classroom cleanliness, ventilation, and prompt reporting of fever, cough, sore throat, or parotid swelling. Health workers and school leadership coordinate to ensure safe chemical use. After one week, risk assessment will continue to monitor transmission and adjust measures to prevent wider spread within schools and the surrounding community. No infection source is disclosed.

article.articleHeadline: This Sickness Almost Took My Life" - VeryDarkMan Hospitalised In China With Life-Threatening Malaria, Faces Days In Quarantine - Information Nigeria

No hospital or medical report has confirmed malaria, and the article notes there is no independent laboratory verification. He has not provided an update since the post. His claim references the severity of malaria and fatalities among Nigerians, but the piece does not present any outbreak, case count, or official confirmation. The report relies on his social-media post, with no corroborating medical documentation.

article.articleSummary: Dengue fever fatality in a 39-year-old woman who was seven months pregnant from Modakkurichi, Erode district. District Health Officer Aruna stated that health teams conducted doorstep surveys, intensified mosquito-control and sanitation measures, and launched dengue-prevention awareness in the area. The case underscores ongoing dengue risk in the Erode-Coimbatore region and the need for vigilant vector control and care for high-risk pregnancies. article.articleHeadline: DBD Mengancam Kalbar: 2.361 Kasus hingga November 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Threatens West Kalimantan: 2,361 Cases as of November 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of week 46 in 2026, Dengue fever is a major threat in West Kalimantan (Kalbar), Indonesia, with 2,361 cases and 11 deaths reported from January–November 2026, primarily around Pontianak. Chikungunya totals reach 1,230 cases (1,179 clinical/suspect and 51 confirmed). Authorities warn against relying on fogging alone, as it only kills adult Aedes aegypti and does not eliminate larvae in water containers. Emphasis is on larval source management via PSN (Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk) and the 3M Plus approach: drain standing water, cover water storage, and dispose or recycle items that collect rainwater; larvivorous fish may be used in suitable sites. Fogging should follow positive dengue findings and epidemiological surveillance. Community participation, routine environmental cleaning, and early reporting of dengue-like symptoms (sudden fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, nausea) are urged. Inter-district coordination continues to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two imported dengue fever cases reported in Hong Kong
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases were reported in Hong Kong from 13 to 19 November 2026, with patients visiting Vietnam and Cambodia during incubation. Cumulative 2026 dengue cases in Hong Kong total 42 (40 imported, 2 local). In 2025, 59 cases (all imported); 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). WHO data show dengue rising: last year >5 million cases and >4,000 deaths in >90 countries; Jan–Sept this year about 2.5 million. Nearby regions remain affected: Bangladesh, Cambodia, Sri Lanka and Vietnam each report >100,000 cases; Indonesia, Malaysia and India also high; Guangdong Province had 586 infections by September. One imported chikungunya case: a 71-year-old man who travelled to Mainland China during incubation; patient is stable. Hong Kong total chikungunya this year is 9 (8 imported, 1 local). Preventive measures include DEET repellents and weekly removal of standing water; report mosquito issues to 1823.

article.articleHeadline: Scoping Review Identifies Factors Driving Tuberculosis Care Delays Across
article.articleSummary: TB care delays across the ten highest-burden countries (China, India, DRC, Indonesia, Mozambique, Myanmar, Nigeria, Philippines, South Africa, Zambia) were surveyed in 81 studies from 2004–2024. Twenty-five studies (2004–2014) and fifty-six (2015–2024) report delays along patient, diagnostic, and treatment milestones. Myanmar (Yangon) had the longest median total delay, 170.6 days; India reported the shortest median delays, 8 days, with wide variation (8–111) days. Mozambique showed the longest health-system delay at 150 days. Among 64 studies with quantitative delays, cross-sectional designs dominated (44) followed by retrospective cohorts (21). Individual factors included older age as a driver of delay in China and India (60+ years) and in South Africa (40+) and Nigeria (45+). DRC had no eligible studies; Philippines and Zambia contributed only single studies. Delays worsen outcomes and transmission, hindering UN/WHO elimination targets; TB cure is ~85% with standard regimens, mortality without treatment ~50%.
